Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At ING we are looking for a Data Analyst




Your role and work environment:




We are looking for a passionate, high-energy Data Analyst to join our Data Consumption and Culture Team of Data & AI Tribe




Our mission is to unlock business value from data by driving adoption, understanding, governance, and effective consumption of trusted data products. We work side by side with business stakeholders, data product teams, and technology teams to ensure that analytics and reporting are:




- Trusted and governed

- Easy to understand and use

- Focused on real impact and decision-making




We operate in a collaborative, business-oriented and data-driven environment, where curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement are part of our DNA.




We are building a team of data partners who help the business make better decisions.

Your key responsibilities:

As a Data Analyst you will:




- Design, build and evolve impactful dashboards and reporting solutions using tools like Power BI and MicroStrategy

- Go beyond reporting: analyze data to generate insights that influence business decisions

- Ensure high standards of data quality, consistency and governance across reporting assets

- Partner with stakeholders to define, challenge and refine KPIs and metrics Translate business needs into clear, scalable and reusable reporting solutions

- Create and maintain functional and technical documentation

- Actively contribute to data adoption and data literacy initiatives across the organization

What are we looking for?




We are looking for someone with drive, curiosity and a strong sense of ownership. If you enjoy working close to the business and turning data into real impact, this role is for you.




Key skills and experience:

- Hands-on experience with BI tools (Power BI, MicroStrategy or similar)

- Strong SQL and data analysis skills

- Ability to communicate complex ideas in a simple way, to both technical and non-technical audiences

- Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset

- Passion for continuous improvement and learning




What do we offer?

The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.




Check out what is waiting for you!




Balance That Works.

We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.

Restaurant card.

So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.




Our house will be your home.

In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!




Health insurance.

For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).




Life insurance.

We help you protect what matters most to you.




Flexible remuneration.

In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…




Free company shuttle.

It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.




Banking benefits.

Special loans with more beneficial conditions.

Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!




More vitality and more belonging

360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose).

Physiotherapy service on site.

Clinics with professional, world-class athletes.

Gympass service.

Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.

International Remote work program.

Get to know Us




We are a team of more than 1800 people sharing one idea: doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.




A fully online bank where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with agile methodologies.




And although we are based in Spain, we are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 40 countries.




We are proud to have a diverse team, and we are committed to continue developing a culture of Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging to foster a culture of collaboration and innovation that represents all collectives in the society.




And even though we look orange on the outside, we are green on the inside. Our ambition in Sustainability is Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clients decide to embark on this journey.




Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA. If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you!




At ING, you belong just as you are. We hire and support people for their talent and potential — and we know that when you can be yourself, you do your best work.




Job Application Safety Reminder




We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

•Apply only via official ING platforms: ING uses Workday and LinkedIn as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn.

•Check the sender’s email carefully: Legitimate communication will always come from @ing.com and/or @myworkday.com.

•No payments or banking details will ever be requested: If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.

Title: Data-analist
Description:
Als Medior Data Analist bij i4talent werk je aan opdrachten bij verschillende opdrachtgevers in de Randstad. Je verdient tussen de €3.800 en €5.720 bruto per maand en komt in dienst bij i4talent, terwijl je als consultant werkt met SQL, Python, Power BI en Azure aan dashboards, analyses, rapportages en datakwaliteit.




Je zit niet vast op één plek. Samen kiezen we opdrachten die passen bij jouw ambities, skills en tempo. De ene opdracht draait om commerciële analyses of klantgedrag, de andere om procesoptimalisatie, forecasting of managementinformatie. Samen kijken we welke omgeving het beste bij jou past.




Jij als gangmaker

Jij kijkt verder dan alleen cijfers. Je wilt begrijpen wat er achter de data zit en welke inzichten organisaties echt helpen vooruit te komen. Je ziet inconsistenties in datasets, stelt kritische vragen over KPI’s en helpt stakeholders om betere beslissingen te nemen op basis van betrouwbare informatie. Of het nu gaat om trendanalyses, dashboards of het verbeteren van datakwaliteit: jij zorgt dat data niet alleen beschikbaar is, maar ook daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt.




Wat ga je doen?

Als Data Analist werk je aan verschillende data- en analysevraagstukken binnen moderne dataomgevingen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

Analyseren van data met SQL en Python om trends, patronen en inzichten zichtbaar te maken.
Ontwikkelen van dashboards en visualisaties in o.a Power BI ter ondersteuning van besluitvorming.
Uitvoeren van analyses op het gebied van KPI’s, klantgedrag, processen en performance.
Vertalen van businessvragen naar concrete analyses en rapportages.
Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en signaleren van inconsistenties in datasets.
Samenwerken met stakeholders, business teams en andere data professionals.
Werken binnen moderne cloud- en dataomgevingen in Azure.
Afhankelijk van de opdracht werk je met technologieën zoals: SQL, Python, Power BI, Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse Analytics en Cloud datawarehouses zoals Snowflake BigQuery.




Wat krijg je van i4talent?

Salaris tussen €3.800 en €5.720 bruto per maand.
Direct een vast contract.
Leaseauto met tankpas, ook privé te gebruiken.
25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld.
Goede pensioenregeling, waarbij i4talent 2/3 van de premie betaalt.
Persoonlijke begeleiding door een Fieldmanager.
Coaching van een Happy professional manager voor inhoud en ontwikkeling.
Toegang tot de i4talent Academy met online en klassikale trainingen (inhoud en soft skills) via onder andere NIVE en Coursera, inclusief erkende certificaten.
Afwisselende opdrachten bij corporates, scale-ups en publieke organisaties.
Events waar je echt bij wilt zijn: Inhoudelijke sessies, borrels, jaarlijkse trips en bootdagen. .




Wat breng jij mee?

Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en nieuwsgierig naar de verhalen achter data.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

Een hbo- of wo-diploma in een kwantitatieve richting.
Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Data Analist of vergelijkbare rol.
Ervaring met SQL en Python.
Ervaring met cloud data warehouses zoals Snowflake of BigQuery.
Ervaring met Power BI of vergelijkbare BI-tools zoals Tableau, Qlik of Looker.
Affiniteit met dashboards, KPI’s en datavisualisatie.
Ervaring met Azure en andere cloudomgevingen is een pré
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en stakeholdermanagement.
Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
Een rijbewijs B en bereidheid om te reizen binnen de Randstad.

Title: Business Intelligence Reporting Analyst
Place: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Si quieres formar parte de una empresa sólida y en continua expansión, ¡esta es tu oportunidad!




Formarás parte de un equipo dinámico y participarás, de manera activa, en el análisis de nuestro negocio.




¿Cómo es el día a día?

Colaborar con los stakeholders de negocio para traducir sus necesidades en requerimientos técnicos para la creación de soluciones de Business Intelligence.
Asegurar la integridad y precisión de los datos, en una infraestructura de SnowFlake y Power BI, a través de la implementación y monitoreo de procesos de validación, garantizando la confiabilidad de los informes para la toma de decisiones estratégicas.
Liderar la definición, gestión y harmonización de los KPI de negocio, colaborando con stakeholders clave para alinear las métricas con los objetivos estratégicos de la compañía y asegurar una medición efectiva del rendimiento.
Diseñar y desarrollar modelos de datos, dashboards e informes avanzados utilizando Power BI para visualizar información clave y facilitar la toma de decisiones.
Realizar análisis de negocio exhaustivos para identificar tendencias, patrones y oportunidades de mejora en el rendimiento operativo y financiero.




¿Qué estamos buscando?

Licenciatura en Ingeniería, Ciencias de la computación, Matemáticas o similares. Se valorarán estudios de postgrado o certificaciones relevantes en Análisis de Datos o áreas relacionadas.
Al menos +3 años de experiencia comprobada como Analista de Negocio o Analista de Datos, preferiblemente en entornos de reporting en roles similares
Dominio avanzado de Power BI para la creación de modelos de datos, dashboards y reportes.
Experiencia trabajando con la infraestructura de datos en SnowFlake.
Manejo avanzado de SQL para la consulta, manipulación y análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos.
Sólidos conocimientos en la gestión de la calidad e integridad de los datos.
Capacidad analítica, pensamiento estratégico y visión de negocio
Excelente capacidad de pensamiento crítico y resolución de problemas.
Habilidades de comunicación para traducir requerimientos de negocio a soluciones técnicas. Alto nivel de proactividad.
Valorable experiencia en el sector QSR
Fluidez en español e inglés.

Formar parte de un proyecto sólido y en continua expansión
Posición estable
Ambiente joven, dinámico e internacional
Horario de oficina
Viernes, julio y agosto en jornada intensiva
Salario negociable de acuerdo a la experiencia
Retribución flexible
1 día de teletrabajo a la semana

Title: Data Analyst Digital Sénior H/F
Description:
Qui sommes-nous ?



Rejoindre NEXTON, c'est intégrer une entreprise où convergent l'esprit d'un cabinet de conseil, la créativité d'une Factory et la dynamique d'une ESN ! Grâce à notre expertise, nous accompagnons des clients grands comptes et des pure players tels que SNCF, Orange, et BNP Paribas dans leurs stratégies d'évolution et d'innovation digitale.



Fondée en 2011, NEXTON réunit aujourd'hui une équipe de plus de 450 experts spécialisés dans le digital, le design, l'agilité, le produit et le développement. Ensemble, ils créent un écosystème riche en connaissances et en compétences diversifiées.





Description du poste



NEXTON recrute un Data Analyst Digital Senior H/F, en CDI, à Montpellier !



Ton futur environnement de travail :



Tu rejoins le Chapitre Data d'un grand compte bancaire, tu pilotes la gouvernance, la qualité et la protection de la donnée au sein de l'entreprise via sa Data Office. Dans ce cadre, tu viens renforcer l'équipe sur les activités de Data Analyse Digital, au service des parcours digitaux et de la compréhension des comportements utilisateurs. L'enjeu : mettre en place, maintenir et exploiter le dispositif de mesure des interactions digitales pour éclairer les décisions stratégiques et opérationnelles.



Tes missions :



Définir et gérer le plan de marquage : recueillir les besoins de tracking auprès des équipes métiers, concevoir et documenter les plans de marquage
Définir les KPIs et métriques pertinents par parcours et objectif business
Spécifier les besoins techniques auprès des équipes de développement et assurer le suivi qualité du tracking
Réaliser les tests et validations des tags déployés et en suivre régulièrement la qualité
Analyser les comportements utilisateurs sur les parcours digitaux et identifier les points de friction et opportunités d'optimisation
Produire des reportings et dashboards de suivi réguliers
Restituer les analyses et insights aux équipes métiers et formuler des recommandations actionnables
Accompagner les équipes dans l'interprétation des données et contribuer à la montée en compétences et à l'amélioration continue des pratiques


Qualifications



De formation supérieure (BAC+5), tu as au moins 6 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst Digital.



Maîtrise des outils d'analyse web, idéalement Piano Analytics
Expérience en Tag Management, idéalement sur Tag Commander
Bonne connaissance des outils de data visualisation : Microstrategy, PowerBI ou Tableau
Maîtrise du SQL pour l'extraction et la manipulation de données
Bonne pratique d'Excel avancé (analyses avancées, tableaux croisés dynamiques)
Connaissances en JavaScript appréciées pour la compréhension du code de tracking

Title: Data Analyst - Marketing
Description:
Juntar-se ao Oney significa embarcar numa grande aventura ao serviço do poder de escolha. Significa integrar uma equipa de 2.600 colaboradores em toda a Europa em torno de um objetivo comum: transformar o comércio e revolucionar os pagamentos.

Significa também ter a liberdade de inventar o seu próprio caminho profissional e a sua forma de trabalhar, de ser criativo e de inovar. Esta é a nossa filosofia. Se você também acredita nisso, junte-se a nós.







Mais do que um trabalho, uma missão!




Estamos à procura de um/a Data Analyst para se juntar à equipa da Direção de Marketing.







Quais as responsabilidades?




- Elaborar e automatizar relatórios, estudos, análises e indicadores de gestão que permitam a pilotagem da atividade e apoiem a tomada de decisão.

- Desenvolver, rever, implementar e monitorizar modelos preditivos de marketing.

- Participar na definição das estratégias de venda e risco dos produtos através da análise e interpretação de dados.

- Garantir a correta segmentação e extração de bases de dados para as campanhas previstas no Plano de Marketing Operacional e Plano de Comércio.

- Assegurar a implementação de campanhas na ferramenta de Marketing Automation, incluindo atualização de segmentos, definição de triggers, fluxos e agendamentos.

- Interagir com diferentes interlocutores e áreas de negócio, compreendendo as suas necessidades e garantindo uma resposta eficaz às solicitações realizadas.

- Colaborar com equipas de diferentes áreas durante os processos de operacionalização de campanhas, testes e revisões estratégicas.

- Criar mecanismos de monitorização e alertas para validação das campanhas antes do envio, assegurando a qualidade e fiabilidade da informação.

- Realizar controlos e validações recorrentes dos dados e processos, garantindo elevados níveis de rigor e qualidade da informação.







O que procuramos?




- Formação superior Gestão, Matemática, Estatística, Gestão de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas similares.

- Experiência mínima de 3 anos em funções semelhantes.

- Conhecimentos sólidos de SQL.

- Experiência em ambientes de Data Warehouse, sendo a experiência com Snowflake valorizada.

- Conhecimentos de Python.

- Experiência em análise de dados e criação de dashboards em Power BI.

- Forte orientação para o negócio e compreensão do impacto das análises na tomada de decisão.

- Excelentes competências de comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal e trabalho em equipa.

- Rigor, atenção ao detalhe e espírito crítico.

- Capacidade para trabalhar de forma próxima com diferentes stakeholders e compreender as necessidades de várias áreas da organização.







O que vai encontrar?




- Uma grande equipa e um excelente ambiente de trabalho!

- Partilha do sucesso e dos resultados da empresa.

- Promoção do bem-estar, uma cultura de abertura e de partilha.

- Regime de trabalho híbrido (2 dias escritório, 3 dias home office).

- Condições e benefícios que promovem o engagement e bem-estar: 29 dias de férias ao ano, seguro de saúde alargado à família, atribuição de telemóvel e clube de descontos com parcerias exclusivas para os nossos colaboradores!

- Investimento na formação e aquisição de competências ao longo do percurso profissional.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup transforming the industry — from enhancing guest experiences to driving business growth.

With a powerful suite of features and integrations with 150+ industry partners, including Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Expedia, and Google Travel, Guesty empowers property managers to deliver exceptional guest experiences while running efficient, data-driven operations.

Today, we're proud to have 800+ team members across 16 countries, all working together to shape the future of hospitality technology.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our Marketing organization. This role will partner closely with Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver actionable insights, develop scalable reporting, analyze campaign performance, and help optimize marketing strategies through data. The ideal candidate has strong SQL expertise, experience with BI tools, and the ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the primary analytics partner for the Marketing team.
Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze large datasets.
Build, maintain, and improve dashboards using Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI tools.
Analyze marketing performance across Google Ads, Facebook Ads, email, paid search, paid social, and organic channels.
Define, monitor, and report on key marketing KPIs, including ROI, ROAS, CAC, LTV, attribution, conversion rate, marketing spend, and campaign performance.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities through data analysis.
Partner with Marketing, Product, and Business teams to support strategic decision-making.
Ensure data quality, consistency, and reporting accuracy across dashboards and reports.
Continuously improve reporting processes through automation and scalable analytics solutions.


Requirements:


3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Marketing Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Analytics Analyst.
Expert-level SQL skills with experience writing complex SQL queries (joins, CTEs, window functions, subqueries, aggregations, query optimization, and data transformation). This is a core requirement.
Strong experience using BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and identify actionable insights.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience building dashboards, reports, and executive-level presentations.
Experience defining and tracking KPIs and business metrics.
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
Strong English communication skills.


Highly Preferred


Experience as a Marketing Data Analyst within a SaaS, IT, software, or technology company.
Experience with Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or similar marketing platforms.
Strong understanding of marketing metrics, including: ROI, ROAS, Attribution, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), Marketing Spend, Conversion Rate
Experience supporting B2B SaaS marketing teams.
Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift.
Experience with Python or R for data analysis is an advantage.
Experience with AI tools or analytics automation is a plus.

Title: AI & Data Analyst
Description:
Qualitas Funds is looking to hire an AI & Data Analyst to accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence and data across the firm, with a primary focus on the investment team.




Qualitas is a private equity manager specialised in the European lower mid-market, with investment strategies across primary funds, co-investments and secondaries. Over the past few years, we have developed a proprietary market intelligence platform, Qualitas Insight, as well as an extensive roadmap of AI initiatives aimed at improving the way we analyse funds, companies, markets and investment opportunities




We are looking for someone with an analytical mindset, strong execution capabilities and genuine curiosity for technology, who wants to combine artificial intelligence, data and investing in a demanding, entrepreneurial environment with high exposure to the senior team.




This is a unique time to join Qualitas Funds. Artificial intelligence and data are a strategic priority for the firm, and this position will play a central role in turning that potential into concrete tools that improve how we analyse opportunities, make decisions and scale our processes. We are looking for someone with the ambition to build, strong execution capabilities and a long-term mindset to grow alongside the project.




The Role:




The position will be integrated into the investment team and will work closely with different departments across the firm, as well as with internal developers and technology partn

ers.The main objective will be to convert already identified business needs into operational tools with real impact on Qualitas’ day-to-day activities. In the short term, the person will be responsible for coordinating and executing AI and data initiatives; over time, we expect the role to evolve into a central position in the continuous improvement of Qualitas’ investment processes.




Responsibilities:




Driving and coordinating artificial intelligence projects applied to the investment team and other areas of the firm.
Translating business needs into concrete solutions, working alongside the investment team, internal developers and technology partners.
Designing, developing and implementing agentic workflows, automations and tools based on generative AI.
Ensuring the effective adoption of existing AI agents and tools, monitoring usage, improvements and new needs.
Contributing to the evolution of Qualitas Insight, our proprietary market intelligence platform.
Performing data analysis on funds, companies, sectors, markets and investment opportuneities.
Participating in the preparation of investment recommendations, both for direct investment opportunities and primary fund investments.
Improving internal investment team processes by identifying opportunities for automation, efficiency and scalability.
Coordinating technology providers, developers and internal stakeholders to ensure execution, quality and timely delivery




Knowledge and Experience




2-3 years of experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, data & analytics, artificial intelligence, product, operations or technology project management.
Ability to understand business needs and translate them into concrete tools.
Familiarity with generative AI and automation tools.
Ability to develop or coordinate agentic workflows independently.
Basic knowledge of SQL and/or Python will be highlyvalued.
Knowledge of corporate finance, private equity or company analysis will be a plus, but is not required
Excellent analytical skills.
Strong organisation and project management capabilities.
Autonomy, proactivity and results orientation.
Strong execution discipline and rigorous follow-up.
Intellectual curiosity and comfort working on new, undefined problems.
Good communication skills with both business and technical profiles.
Ability to work from a blank sheet of paper and turn ideas into operational solutions.

We are looking for someone with an analytical mindset, strong execution capabilities and genuine curiosity for technology, who wants to combine artificial intelligence, data and investing in a demanding, entrepreneurial environment with high exposure to the senior team.


This is a unique time to join Qualitas Funds. Artificial intelligence and data are a strategic priority for the firm, and this position will play a central role in turning that potential into concrete tools that improve how we analyse opportunities, make decisions and scale our processes. We are looking for someone with the ambition to build, strong execution capabilities and a long-term mindset to grow alongside the project.


The Role:


The position will be integrated into the investment team and will work closely with different departments across the firm, as well as with internal developers and technology partn

ers.The main objective will be to convert already identified business needs into operational tools with real impact on Qualitas’ day-to-day activities. Responsibilities:


  • Driving and coordinating artificial intelligence projects applied to the investment team and other areas of the firm.
  • Translating business needs into concrete solutions, working alongside the investment team, internal developers and technology partners.
  • Designing, developing and implementing agentic workflows, automations and tools based on generative AI.

  • Contributing to the evolution of Qualitas Insight, our proprietary market intelligence platform.
  • Performing data analysis on funds, companies, sectors, markets and investment opportuneities.
  • Participating in the preparation of investment recommendations, both for direct investment opportunities and primary fund investments.
  • Improving internal investment team processes by identifying opportunities for automation, efficiency and scalability.
  • Coordinating technology providers, developers and internal stakeholders to ensure execution, quality and timely delivery


Knowledge and Experience


  • 2-3 years of experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, data & analytics, artificial intelligence, product, operations or technology project management.
  • Ability to understand business needs and translate them into concrete tools.
  • Familiarity with generative AI and automation tools.
  • Ability to develop or coordinate agentic workflows independently.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL and/or Python will be highlyvalued.
  • Knowledge of corporate finance, private equity or company analysis will be a plus, but is not required
  • Excellent analytical skills.
  • Strong organisation and project management capabilities.
  • Autonomy, proactivity and results orientation.
  • Strong execution discipline and rigorous follow-up.
  • Intellectual curiosity and comfort working on new, undefined problems.
  • Good communication skills with both business and technical profiles.
  • Ability to work from a blank sheet of paper and turn ideas into operational solutions.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Join our team as a Data Analyst and start a new adventure in an international and dynamic environment, where you will be able to fulfill your career expectations in a fast-growing organization. As a Data Analytics Consultant, you will play a key role in evaluating and analyzing telematics datasets to support engineering functions and performance analysis for vehicles, subsystems, and components.




Your Missions

Evaluate telematics datasets for consistency, accuracy, and suitability to ensure reliable input for vehicle, subsystem, and component performance analysis.
Analyze telematics data to identify trends, correlations, and performance factors supporting simulation model optimization and validation use case refinement.
Assess vehicle usage data and operational patterns to help define representative customer missions and use case clusters.
Monitor performance metrics contributing to component health assessment, durability, and long-term performance trends, enabling predictive failure rate estimation.
Create advanced dashboards, reports, and data visualizations to clearly communicate analytical results, performance trends, and optimization opportunities to engineering and business stakeholders.




Your Profile

Experience in data analytics and data mining techniques, preferably in the automotive sector or related fields (2-3years).
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and MATLAB, with experience using data manipulation and analysis libraries.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI and dashboard creation.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related STEM disciplines.
English fluent. Italian mother tongue
You demonstrate strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
You demonstrate effective communication and collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork.
You show a passion for sustainable transportation and a desire to contribute to a greener future.
Experience with large datasets and database structures.
Understanding of vehicle telematics concepts and connected vehicle data.
Knowledge of machine learning or clustering methods is a plus.




What do we offer?

An international community bringing together more than 110 nationalities.
• An environment where trust is central and internal growth is valued.
• A solid training system with an internal Academy and available learning modules.
• A dynamic workplace with internal events, team building activities and dedicated initiatives.
• A strong commitment to well-being and work-life balance.







Local benefits in Italy:

Meal vouchers.
• Flexible working options according to company policy.
• Health insurance and well-being programs, where applicable.

Gross AnnualSalary (Range: EUR 24,000 – EUR 36,000)
• Applicable CCNL: Commerce Sector (CCNL Commercio).
• The salary range has been determined based on objective and gender-neutral criteria.
• During the recruitment process, we will not ask for information about your current or previous salary.

Title: Data Analyst en alternance
Description:
À la recherche d’une expérience au service d’une marque patrimoniale, engagée et audacieuse ?

Rejoignez Nature & Découvertes !







Chez Nature & Découvertes, nous sommes convaincus que le vivant est un cadeau.




Portés par la passion et par nos convictions, nous avons fait le pari singulier, dès notre création en 1990, de faire du commerce dans le respect de l’humain et de la nature. Depuis, ce sont nos actions qui le prouvent : 150 projets associatifs soutenus par notre Fondation chaque année, notre certification B Corp, obtenue dès 2015, et notre statut de société à mission, depuis fin 2022.




Nos univers phares - bien-être, outdoor, maison, jeux-jouets et librairie - sont composés d’une sélection de produits exigeante, singulière et experte.




Avec plus de 90 magasins en Europe et près de 900 collaborateurs, nous nous engageons également à accompagner le développement des équipes, notamment grâce à notre école de formation interne.




Au sein de l’équipe Data Analytics de Nature & Découvertes, nous recherchons une alternance en Data Analyst pour nous aider à traiter l’ensemble des données disponibles, afin de développer la connaissance de nos clients dans l’entreprise, suivre et optimiser l’efficacité des actions, développer et maintenir des outils innovants pour exploiter la data clients.




• Management et Structuration de la donnée

- Nous faisons régulièrement évoluer notre modèle de données afin de couvrir l’ensemble des besoins analytics de Nature & Découvertes (structuration, optimisation et intégration de nouvelles données).- Vous participez à la définition du modèle et des indicateurs pour garantir la fiabilité des

données.




• Reportings et Études clients




- Vous avez en charge l’élaboration des reportings et les faites évoluer.

- Vous analysez les résultats et les mettez en forme via des techniques de visualisation.

- Vous mesurez la performance des opérations marketing mises en place (A/B test, Offres commerciales …)- Vous participez à la réalisation d’études sur les comportements clients (omnicanalité, activité, churn …)




• Modélisation data




- Vous travaillerez sur au moins un projet de modélisation data dans l’outil DATAIKU.

- Vous intégrerez l’équipe data analytics composée de 1 personne.

Environnement : Hadoop / logiciels utilisés (BI : MicroStrategy) Dataiku / Python




PROFIL




Bac +4/5, école de statistiques ou ingénieur spécialisée en data

- Vous savez manipuler les bases de données.

- Vous connaissez SQL et Python

- Vous avez déjà utilisé Excel et Power Point

- Vous connaissez les principales techniques de modélisation (segmentation, scoring, associations de produits …)




Qualités souhaitées :




Nous privilégions la cocréation et le travail en équipe. Nous espérons que vous aussi !




Vous êtes une personne curieuse, polyvalente, vous aimez travailler sur des problématiques variées. Vous faites preuve d’autonomie et êtes force de proposition.

Vous êtes une personne rigoureuse et vous avez le sens du détail !Aussi, vous avez une sensibilité marketing et des capacités de communication écrite et orale.




Poste basé sur notre Siège Social de Versailles (78), situé face à la gare de Versailles Chantiers (liaison RER C et Ligne N). Accord télétravail et mobilité durable.




Remboursement des frais de transport à hauteur de 71%, carte tickets restaurants et accès aux avantages du CSE.




Ce que vous pensiez être une différence, sera notre force de demain. Ce poste est ouvert à tous les talents du mon de et toute sa diversité.

Continuous improvement mindset
Communication skills
Problem solving

Description du poste



Pour accompagner son développement, Sia recrute un(e) consultant(e) Data Analyst.

Echanger avec les différentes parties prenantes pour comprendre et définir les besoins métiers
Se coordonner avec les intervenants techniques pour anticiper les risques

Explorer les résultats des analyses en utilisant la Data Visualisation

Le développement ou le renforcement de notre activité au travers de formations, de groupes de travail, de diffusion de support internes et externes...
La contribution au rayonnement du cabinet par le biais de publications (articles, études, etc.), et la participation à différents salons et événements
Le développement commercial en contribuant à la définition des besoins et en participant aux actions commerciales


Qualifications


Formation de haut niveau (Bac +5) en université, école d'ingénieur ou de commerce, dans le domaine de la data
Expérience initiale souhaitée en tant qu'analyste de données ou en visualisation de données
Solides connaissances en BI et Data Visualisation, incluant les concepts, méthodologies et outils pertinents
Expérience avec des outils BI tels que Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, etc.
Maîtrise de SQL et de Python pour la manipulation et l'analyse des données
Compréhension des techniques d'extraction, de transformation et de chargement des données (ETL), avec préférence pour une expérience avec des outils ETL (e.g. Dataiku)
Une expérience sur des plates-formes telles qu'Azure, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, est un atout

Vous souhaitez vous impliquer et prendre rapidement des responsabilités sur des missions à forte valeur ajoutée au sein d’une structure dynamique et en croissance.



Vous disposez d'une appétence pour les enjeux liés à la data et l'IA, d'une capacité à monter en compétences rapidement sur ces sujets et êtes enthousiaste à l'idée d'accompagner nos clients à en saisir les opportunités.

Title: Asset Management Data Analyst
Description:
At Taylor Hopkinson, we are currently recruiting an Asset Management Data Analyst for a company focused on the development and operation of utility-scale solar projects across Spain.




Role Overview

As an Asset Management Data Analyst, you will play a key role in monitoring and optimizing the performance of a portfolio of operating solar assets. You will analyze asset performance, support reporting activities and provide data-driven insights that contribute to operational excellence and long-term asset value.




Key Responsibilities

Monitor the operational performance of utility-scale solar assets, tracking technical and financial KPIs.
Analyze production data, availability and performance trends to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
Support the preparation of operational, financial and ESG reports for the asset portfolio.
Review technical documentation, maintenance activities and contractual performance.
Assist in budget tracking and performance analysis, ensuring alignment between operational and financial data.
Collaborate with internal teams including Operations, Finance, Legal and Investment to support effective asset management.
Contribute to process improvements, KPI development and continuous performance optimization.




Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Data Analytics, Finance or a related discipline.
Previous experience in renewable energy, asset management, data analytics or a similar analytical role.
Advanced Excel skills are essential; Power BI experience is highly desirable.
Professional proficiency in English.

You will engage in the entire client lifecycle, from client onboarding to daily client support with the development of bespoke solutions for our clients.

This role combines analytical work with a strong client-facing component and requires building a solid understanding of capital markets, financial instruments, and regulatory frameworks.

Key responsibilities:

Client Implementation - Analyse clients' data and collaborate with developers to build custom solutions for clients ranging from top-tier banks to investment firms in various locations

Data-Driven Decision Making - Investigate various data sets using a range of tools to make data-driven decisions

Client Engagement - Offer product demonstrations, lead client onboardings and manage errors to ensure a seamless service delivery

Quality Assurance - Ensure the usability, quality and delivery of features and the product as a whole

Continuous Improvement - Analyse and understand the needs and priorities of clients to build a better product

Experience in the Financial Services industry or knowledge of Financial Instruments and Markets will be considered an advantage

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Attention to detail

Positive – Has a positive attitude, optimistic

Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills

Strong communication and collaboration skills

Team player – actively contributes and supports the team to achieve a common goal

Competitive remuneration package

Title: Data Analyst
HTML:
At Bloq.it, we’ve created the world’s leading smart locker solution. Solving online deliveries by enabling everyone to participate easily, reducing delivery costs and making them more sustainable.

We’re quickly expanding, and after growing at 1000% for three years in a row, we’re now the fastest-growing Smart Locker company in the world and one of the fastest growing scale-ups in Europe.

We are in search of a Data Analyst to join our innovative team as our new #bloqstar! As a Data Analyst within our Operations Strategy team, you'll help build the analytical infrastructure that powers decision-making across field operations in nine countries - you'll be a translator of business and operational requirements into analytical demands.

You'll report to the Data Analytics Manager and work hands-on with data, models, and AI-powered tools that have direct operational impact.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Build and maintain KPI reporting infrastructure across operational markets, ensuring data accuracy and consistency;
  • Develop predictive models to support operational planning;
  • Contribute to AI-powered tools that reduce manual work at scale across our field operations teams;
  • Analyse large operational datasets to identify patterns, anomalies, and root causes of performance deviations;
  • Translate complex analytical outputs into clear, actionable insights for operational stakeholders;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Operations, Product, Data Platform) to align on data definitions and business logic;
  • Support the migration and integration of data sources as our operational stack evolves.

What You’ll Bring To The Table

  • 2-4 years of experience in a data analyst or data scientist role;
  • Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets);
  • Experience building dashboards or reporting tools (Looker or similar);
  • Ability to work with messy, real-world operational data and turn it into reliable outputs;
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous, environment where priorities regularly shift;
  • Strong communication skills: you can explain analytical work to non-technical stakeholders;
  • Strong business acumen: you understand operational context, ask the right questions, and know that analytical output is only as good as the problem framing behind it and the narrative presenting it.

It Would Be Great If You Would Also Have

  • Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks;
  • Familiarity with cloud data environments and DevOps practices;
  • Experience in logistics, field services, or other operationally complex industries.

Why join us?

  • The opportunity to join our Operations Strategy team and play a pivotal role in contributing to innovative solutions that redefine Bloq.it's revolution in the smart locker industry ;
  • A dynamic and fast-paced work environment with a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning ;
  • Competitive salary and flexible benefits package, tailored to your experience and skills ;
  • Eligibility for performance-based bonus, tied to your results and designed to reward your impact ;
  • Work how you work best - we offer a remote-friendly policy and flexible hours so you can stay productive and keep life balanced ;
  • Portuguese Health Insurance including mental health ;
  • Flexible Sports and Wellness membership covering multiple gyms and studios ;
  • Unlimited days off (subject to manager approval).

We value diversity and solidarity within Bloq.it, this position is open to all candidates.

If you require any special arrangements during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can accommodate you in the best possible way.

Ready to join the revolution?

At Bloq.it, we provide end-to-end solutions for Smart Lockers, and our software ecosystem, Bloq.it OS, is the leading tech solution available in the market.

We've had the pleasure of working with some of the biggest names in e-commerce, logistics, and retail in Europe, such as Vinted and DHL.

We have recently become the fastest-growing Smart Locker company in the world. Before Bloq.it the industry had stagnated and lacked innovation and good products. We strive to have the same impact in this industry as Tesla has had on the car industry.

We believe that Smart Lockers are a big part of the future for everyone, and we want to play our part in making sure that Smart Lockers become as mainstream as the mobile phone.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst | GBL Tech




At GBL Tech, we drive high-impact technology careers through specialization and scale. We operate across critical digital ecosystems — from Fintech to Smart Industry — connecting talent with technically challenging projects and modern stacks.




The Role

We're looking for a Data Analyst with deep expertise in Power BI to orchestrate enterprise Analytics and Business Intelligence solutions. This role goes far beyond dashboard development, requiring an engineer who masters the full analytics lifecycle — from data ingestion and semantic modeling to governance, security, and enterprise platform administration within large-scale data environments.




Your Mission:

Enterprise BI Architecture: Design, develop, and optimize advanced semantic data models (Star Schema, Fact & Dimension modeling) and maintain centralized datasets using Microsoft Fabric capabilities (Lakehouse, Mirroring, Warehouse, and Data Pipelines).
Platform Governance & Security: Manage complex Power BI Workspaces, Apps, and Deployment Pipelines, while implementing rigorous Row-Level Security (RLS) to support multiple international business areas and geographies.
Requirements & Analytics Engineering: Collaborate directly with business users to facilitate requirements gathering workshops, translating complex needs into high-performance analytical solutions and metrics using advanced DAX.
Data Ecosystem Collaboration: Partner closely with Data Engineering and Data Platform teams to integrate multiple data sources, including SQL Server, APIs, and Cloud Data Platforms, ensuring performance and scalability.




What We Are Looking For:

Expertise Level: Strong, proven trajectory as an Expert Data Analyst leading full-lifecycle BI initiatives in large-scale enterprise environments.
Fabric & Power BI Mastery: Deep, hands-on command of Microsoft Fabric ecosystem along with Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service administration.
Data Engineering & SQL: Robust knowledge of SQL, automated data ingestion pipelines, and the optimization of heavy datasets and semantic structures.
Soft Skills & Autonomy: Proactive, autonomous, and results-driven profile with outstanding communication skills to face business stakeholders and bridge the gap between business and engineering.
Nice to have: Experience with Snowflake, Azure Data Platform, SSAS Tabular, Azure DevOps, CI/CD for Power BI (Git integration, REST API, XMLA Endpoints), or advanced tuning tools like Tabular Editor and DAX Studio.




Interested?

If this project speaks to you, or you're looking for a similar challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About the job




At Netzet, we’re all about creativity, innovation, and big ambitions. Ever wondered what it’s like to spend $1 million a day on digital ads? We’re not there yet, but we’re well on our way.




Who we are

Right now, we’re scaling several of our brands across 50+ countries. What makes us different? We don’t just scale businesses—we build them from the ground up. We’ve mastered the art of growing brands quickly and consistently, and we’ve proven it time and time again. Our biggest win so far? One of the brands we built was acquired by a NASDAQ-listed company. It’s just the beginning of what we’re capable of.







We’re looking for a hands-on Data Analyst to join our team. You don't need to be a highly advanced expert - we are looking for a true "numbers person" who loves to dig into data, figure out why things are happening, and isn't afraid to experiment.







What you’ll do:

Payment Analysis & Optimization: You will closely monitor our payment systems, helping the team with pure data analysis. Your goal will be to identify patterns, find missing information, and help make our payment processes as efficient as possible
Investigate Day-to-Day Puzzles: You’ll handle incoming tasks from project owners. While we have a Data Warehouse, you won’t just be looking at surface-level numbers. You will regularly need to dig in manually, trace where the data comes from, and invest time to understand why the numbers look the way they do
Business & Expansion Strategy: You’ll look for ways to improve our business projects. For example, when we launch in new locales, you’ll help us analyze the data to set targets, such as determining the optimal average spend per user
Leverage AI: You will work heavily with Claude and other AI tools on a daily basis. We expect you to use AI to speed up your work, analyze data faster, and solve problems creatively




What we’re looking for:

The "Numbers" Mindset: You don't need years of senior experience, but you must be a logical, curious person who naturally understands numbers and business metrics
Core Tech Skills: Strong proficiency in Excel. Basic knowledge of SQL is a great plus
Investigative Nature: You have the patience and curiosity to manually investigate data sources and understand the root causes behind the metrics
Fearless & Adaptable: You aren't afraid to try new things, make mistakes, learn, and use modern AI tools to amplify your daily work







What to expect:

You’ll join a small, friendly team where people are open, direct, and easy to work with
We keep things practical - no heavy processes or unnecessary layers
You’ll work with teammates who know their craft and care about doing things well
There’s variety: different products, different challenges, and enough change to keep the work from feeling routine
We use solid, modern tools (including AI) that actually help, not slow you down
Team culture matters to us - workations, bike rides, game nights, lunches, and whatever else we decide to do together.
Salary starts from €3000 gross per month. The final offer will depend on your overall experience and competencies.







Join us!

If you want to be part of our growing team, apply now or reach out directly at gabriele@netzet.com — let's have a chat!

Title: Data Analyst Intern
Description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

YOUR MISSION

You will be at the heart of Glovo's Global Logistics and Operations team, owning the data work behind how we design, test, and optimize the order compensation structures that reward our riders across 23 countries. This is one of the highest impact areas in the company, rider payments are our largest operational cost, and every model you build or experiment you run translates directly into business outcomes at scale.

The environment is fast moving. Priorities shift and ad hoc requests come in regularly. This internship is built for someone curious, hands-on, and eager to learn how real operational decisions get made with data. You will be paired with experienced analysts who will mentor you along the way.

THE JOURNEY


Support the team in modelling and reviewing order payment structures that improve engagement and operational efficiency.
You will be using SQL to query large datasets to surface trends, answer business questions quickly, and build the analytical foundation for strategic decisions.
Translate findings into action. You will help present insights to non-technical stakeholders in a way that is concise and convincing.
Support the design and running of experiments that validate setting changes before global rollout. You will be exposed to the full cycle: design, execution, and analysis.
Leverage AI in your workflow. You will actively incorporate AI tools (agents, copilots, and LLM-assisted analysis) into your day to day work to move faster and work smarter.
Monitor and iterate. Track KPIs, spot anomalies, and make data driven adjustments on an ongoing basis.
Understand the rider perspective to ensure models are fair, locally relevant, and operationally sound.


Qualifications

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE


Recently completed a degree or master's in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or another quantitative field.
SQL is essential. You can write queries to pull and filter data, join tables, and aggregate results on your own.
Python familiarity. You can use pandas (or similar) to manipulate data and automate simple tasks.
Excel / spreadsheet familiarity. You know your way around formulas, pivot tables, and structuring data cleanly.
Strong problem-solving instincts. You can take an ambiguous question, break it down, and work toward a clear answer without waiting to be told exactly how.
Fluent English is a must. You communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Nice-to-haves


Hands-on experience leveraging AI in your workflow: copilots, agents, or LLM-assisted analysis used to move faster and work smarter.
Exposure to data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
Any exposure to experimentation (A/B testing, switchback tests, or similar).

InPost Group is an innovative European out of home deliveries company, revolutionizing the way parcels are delivered to customers. With operations across several countries, our network of intelligent lockers provides customers with a fast, convenient, and secure delivery option. InPost Group is a publicly traded company, with a market capitalization of about $5 billion as of March 2023. With over 10,000 people worldwide, InPost Group is one of the largest out of home delivery providers in Europe, committed to providing sustainable and efficient delivery solutions to meet the evolving needs of customers in today's rapidly changing landscape.

Job Description

In this role, you will be responsible for delivering high‑quality data, insights, and analytics that empower managers to make accurate, data‑driven product, campaign, and operational decisions. You will help optimize processes—such as merchant onboarding and servicing within the Pay product—by identifying trends, anomalies, and risks to support more effective (cost‑ and time‑efficient, and occasionally PR‑sensitive) management of the area.

Key Responsibilities


Power BI Reporting & Dashboard Management Prepare, develop, and maintain Power BI reports (transactional and operational dashboards) to support effective decision‑making in product development, deployments, and marketing activities.
End‑to‑End Analytical Support Conduct comprehensive analyses, interpret complex datasets, and present clear, concise conclusions and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.
Trend & Anomaly Detection Identify trends, patterns, deviations, and anomalies (e.g., campaign performance, transaction result outliers) and communicate findings to relevant teams for managerial action.
Data & Dashboard Optimization Activities Participate in projects aimed at refining the maintenance, aggregation, and structuring of dashboards to improve efficiency and workspace organization within the Pay team.
Analytical Contribution to Business Cases Support the development of business cases—including those requiring large or multi‑source datasets—for budgeting, financial planning, and strategic initiatives.
Business Analysis for Non‑Reported Areas Perform business analyses for sales, product, growth, payments, or operational topics where no ongoing reporting exists or where data retrieval requires advanced database querying.
Coordination Between Data & Business Teams Facilitate collaboration between Data and Business teams to streamline planning processes, enhance Data team understanding of business needs, and accelerate implementation timelines.



Qualifications


Proven ability to work with large datasets, including advanced SQL skills, query optimization, and reporting process automation (including VBA).
Experience with Business Intelligence tools, especially Power BI (Power Query, DAX).
Basic programming knowledge in Python (including PySpark).
Strong working knowledge of Databricks or similar platforms.
Highly developed analytical thinking and problem‑solving mindset.
Ability to translate data into actionable insights and business‑oriented recommendations.
Skill in creating clear, logical, user‑friendly, and visually appealing data visualizations and reports.
Solid understanding of statistics and mathematics at a practical level.



Additional Information

The option to work from the office or 100% remotely
Opportunity to work in a diverse, international and cross-functional environment, along with leading experts.
Fulfilling careers with a range of benefits and invests in providing training opportunities for their development.
Involvement in technology monitoring and choices
Your impact will be visible instantly and you will be making a difference in our users lives
We offer B2B type of contract

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Analysts and Scientists ‌work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering smart, scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to support regulatory reporting. You'll work with complex data structures, adapting them to strict specifications, and ensure solutions are efficient and reliable.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What You'll Be Doing


Supporting the Finance team with financial planning, treasury operations, financial strategy, and regulatory reporting
Building and adapting data models and ETL processes for regulatory reporting
Maintaining and improving reporting infrastructure, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and high data quality
Translating complex requirements into clear, efficient data solutions
Understanding our business and its processes through our data
Monitoring and improving data reliability, applying high attention to detail
Designing key metrics to measure different aspects of the business
Creating and maintaining new aggregated views and tables to simplify data querying
Maintaining and creating dashboards to track metrics and visualise insights
Collaborating closely with Regulatory Reporting Managers to understand reporting logic and operational processes


What You'll Need


4+ years experience with SQL, and a solid understanding of complex data systems
Experience in an analytical role, creating impactful solutions
Great collaboration skills to partner with Regulatory Reporting Managers and cross-functional teams
A background or education in a quantitative discipline
To be detail-oriented, quality-focused, and able to deliver under time constraints
Proficiency with Python or other programming languages
The ability to adjust data to strict regulatory specifications
Solid mathematical and statistics knowledge
A proactive mindset with sense of urgency


Nice to have


Experience in finance, banking, and/or accounting
An advanced degree in a core STEM subject
Proficiency with additional programming languages, such as Java, Scala, or C++
To have participated in school/university Olympiad competitions in physics, maths, economics, or programming

As a Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d), you will be a part of the Commercial Intelligence Team within our Commercial Analytics unit. You will be responsible for strengthening our analytics capabilities and directly impacting the company’s success. In this highly visible role, you will drive the development of analytical products and standards that enable data‑driven pricing, marketing, and revenue decisions across the organization. Working closely with Revenue Management and Commercial Excellence, and Marketing stakeholders, you will translate complex data into actionable insights and scalable, automated solutions that support profitable and sustainable growth.

Proven experience building, maintaining, and optimizing reporting solutions in Power BI and Excel
Ability to proactively identify new reporting needs and improve existing analytical processes with business stakeholders
Hands-on, autonomous, and well‑organized working style suited for a highly visible, impact‑driven role
Experience translating business questions into insights and clearly communicating findings to non‑technical audiences

Experience working in Agile team environments, ideally alongside other analysts

Description:
Aperçu de votre journée

Dans le cadre d’un contrat en alternance, vous évoluez dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution, au cœur des activités d’amélioration continue de Siemens Gamesa en France. En lien étroit avec les équipes métiers, vous exploitez la donnée pour automatiser les processus, soutenir la prise de décision et contribuer concrètement à la transition énergétique. Votre quotidien combine analyse de données, création de tableaux de bord, collaboration transverse et développement de solutions à fort impact, tout en conciliant formation académique et expérience professionnelle.

Comment vous ferez la différence


Travailler en binôme avec l’équipe Amélioration Continue pour automatiser et optimiser les processus
Analyser et valoriser les données afin de répondre aux besoins métiers et proposer des plans d’action
Collecter, nettoyer et structurer des données issues de différentes sources
Concevoir des tableaux de bord et rapports via Power BI, Tableau ou Excel
Collaborer avec les équipes internes afin de transformer la donnée en décisions actionnables
Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de collecte, d’analyse et de reporting, dans le cadre d’une alternance



Ce que vous apportez


Étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieur, à la recherche d’une alternance (temps partiel) en Data, Statistiques, Informatique décisionnelle ou domaine équivalent
Très bonne maîtrise des outils de données, notamment Excel, Power BI, Python et SQL
Solides capacités analytiques, esprit de synthèse et force de proposition
Aisance dans un environnement en évolution constante
Maîtrise de l’anglais courant, à l’écrit comme à l’oral
Une première expérience en stage ou en alternance est un atout apprécié



À propos de l’équipe

Chez Siemens Gamesa, nous nous engageons à maximiser la performance et la fiabilité de nos éoliennes. Notre équipe est dédiée à garantir un environnement de travail sûr et efficace tout en minimisant les temps d’arrêt et en améliorant l’excellence opérationnelle. Nous croyons en la promotion d’un environnement de travail collaboratif et inclusif où chaque membre de l’équipe peut contribuer à notre succès.

Qui est Siemens Energy?

Siemens Energy est bien plus qu’une simple entreprise spécialisée dans les technologies énergétiques. Avec nos ~100,000 employés dévoués, répartis dans plus de 90 pays, nous élaborons les futurs systèmes énergétiques, en veillant à répondre à l’augmentation des besoins en énergie de la communauté mondiale de manière fiable et durable. Les technologies créées dans nos départements de recherche et nos usines favorisent la transition énergétique et constituent la base d’un sixième de la production mondiale d’électricité.

Notre équipe mondiale s’engage à faire de l’énergie durable, fiable et abordable une réalité en repoussant les limites du possible. Notre héritage de 150 ans d’innovation nous encourage à rechercher des personnes qui soutiendront nos objectifs en matière de décarbonisation, de nouvelles technologies et de transformation énergétique.

Découvrez comment vous pouvez faire la différence chez Siemens Energy :

https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Notre engagement en faveur de la diversité

Nous croyons que la diversité crée plus d’opportunités de succès. C’est pourquoi nous recrutons des esprits brillants de tous horizons, indépendamment du genre, de l’âge, de l’origine ethnique, de l’orientation sexuelle ou du handicap. Notre objectif principal est de trouver des individus du monde entier capables de contribuer à des technologies qui changent le monde.

Rétributions


Des opportunités de dévelopment professionnel et d’avancement de carrière au sein de l’organisation.
Un environnement de travail favorable qui valorise le travail d’équipe et la collaboration.
Si vous êtes prêt à relever ce défi et à contribuer à nos initiatives de maintenance, nous vous invitons à postuler et à rejoindre notre équipe chez Siemens Gamesa !

As a pioneer in scientific optics, it's employees across the globe continue to push the boundaries of what is possible. With a strong focus on quality and innovation, ZEISS creates value for its customers and helps shape new ways of seeing the world.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst & Administrator Trainee to join us in Lisbon, Portugal.

This role focuses on data analytics and programming, leveraging SQL, Python, Power BI, and dashboard deployment. The ideal candidate will support the team in enhancing data-driven decision-making processes and improving the quality management system.

Dashboard Development: Design and develop interactive dashboards using Power BI to visualize key quality metrics and trends. Ensure dashboards are user-friendly and provide actionable insights.
Programming and Automation: Develop scripts and tools in Python to automate data processing and reporting tasks. Enhance efficiency and accuracy of data handling.
Quality Data Management: Assist in maintaining and improving the quality data infrastructure. Ensure data integrity and consistency across different systems.
Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand their data needs and provide solutions. Communicate findings and recommendations effectively to stakeholders.

Education: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation. Strong programming skills in Python for data analysis and automation. o Experience with Power BI for dashboard creation and data visualization.
Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze complex data sets and derive meaningful insights. Strong problem-solving skills.
Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail in data handling and reporting.
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to present data findings clearly and concisely.
Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. Willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.

Experience with other data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau).
Knowledge of statistical analysis and machine learning techniques.
Familiarity with quality management systems and standards.

Gain hands-on experience in data analytics and programming within a global quality context.

Title: Data Analyst, Product
Description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst, Product to join our team remotely. The #1 goal of this role is to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that improve user experience, support the development of new features, deepen engagement, and help leadership make high-impact product decisions.

You’ll own end-to-end data management from production-grade pipelines and dbt models to dashboards and metric frameworks for the Pro product team. You'll define north star metrics from the ground up, drive experimentation infrastructure through A/B testing and causal inference, and translate results into clear product recommendations. We're actively building a culture where AI tooling is part of how we work, from LLM-augmented pipelines to GenAI-assisted workflows, and we're looking for people who are excited to grow alongside that.

Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with deep knowledge of client retention funnels and user behaviour. You bring experience from environments where data quality has real consequences and where you've had to build the infrastructure, not just use it.

The opportunity


Operate as a full-stack data analyst within the Pro team, owning your domain completely while collaborating closely with colleagues across the pod.
Own the design and evolution of dashboards, north star metrics and analytical frameworks that drive decisions at the highest level of the business.
Build and maintain data infrastructure at scale, from scalable dbt models and production pipelines to full-funnel reporting that powers cross-functional teams.
Lead experimentation across the Product domain by designing and owning A/B testing frameworks, applying causal inference techniques and turning results into clear, confident recommendations that influence product strategy.
Influence technical direction across the data team, contributing to how we build, what we prioritise and how we raise the bar on data quality and engineering standards.
Embed AI tooling into your workflow in ways that have tangible business impact, including LLM-augmented pipelines and GenAI-assisted analytics workflows.
Deliver insights through clear, data-driven storytelling to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.


What You Bring


7+ years of experience in data analytics or analytics engineering, ideally within fintech, payments, financial market or crypto where data quality and scale are non-negotiable.
You have hands-on experience with advanced trading products and solutions in equities, crypto, or other assets. You either have a professional background working within financial markets or on a trading desk, or you are a professional trader.
Hands-on experience building and owning production data pipelines, with strong familiarity with dbt and Airflow or equivalent orchestration tools.
Full mastery of SQL including complex joins, CTEs and analytical functions, alongside strong Python proficiency for pipeline development and analysis.
Hands-on experience designing and running A/B tests and experimentation frameworks, with the ability to apply causal inference techniques and translate results into clear growth recommendations.
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional data initiatives from design to delivery, with measurable business outcomes you can point to.
Strong communicator who can simplify complex data ideas for both technical and non-technical audiences.
A degree in a field emphasising analytical rigour such as software engineering, economics or a hard science.
Based in Canada, the US, the UK or the EU and fluent in English.


Nice to haves


Experience with LLM-augmented analytics pipelines or AI-assisted workflows in a production environment

contratto di apprendistato professionalizzante, tempo pieno

percorso di formazione continua e affiancamento costante

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
Become a

Business Analyst

Full-time

Wien

You’re a data-driven problem solver who enjoys turning information into clear insights and actionable business value? Do you like understanding business needs, translating them into requirements, and working closely with stakeholders and development teams to shape successful projects?

If you’re passionate about bridging the gap between business and technology and shaping smarter solutions, this role is for you! Become our next Business Analyst!

Apply

What we are looking for

You’ll be working in one of our teams consisting of Software and Requirements Engineers. Most of our teams are responsible for a single client and multiple software products. As a Business Analyst, you are part of every step in the process of managing large-scale software products.


Analytical thinking


You have a strong analytical mindset with the ability to gather, interpret and synthesize complex data from various sources.


Make an impact


You look forward to shaping the environment you work in.


Eager to learn


You are familiar with Agile methodologies and project management principles and are eager to continuously develop your skills and knowledge of new tools.


Detail-oriented


You pay close attention to details and take a structured approach to your work, ensuring that nothing important is overlooked and everything is clearly documented.


Qualified


You have completed your studies in a relevant field and bring at least 2 years of experience in an analytical role such as Business Analyst or Requirements Engineer or a similar analytical role.

What you will be doing

Business Process Analysis & Requirements Documentation

Conduct through analysis of existing business processes, systems, and workflows to identify areas for improvement. Develop and maintain detailed documentation of business requirements, user stories, process flows, and functional specifications.

Business Development & Sales

Support business development and sales initiatives by identifying new project opportunities and contributing to the company’s growth strategy and execution.

Team

Collaboration

Collaborate with stakeholders to define requirements and project scope, and work in international Scrum teams to ensure alignment between business and technical teams for smooth project delivery.

Your career path.

We believe that learning never stops. We tackle challenges together by sharing ideas and expertise. At &amp, we are eager to learn from each other, books, conferences, courses, or trying out.

Skill levels

At &amp the best people, not the people who manage to attract the most attention, get promoted. We clearly define and communicate skill levels for your career. You will know at any point how to reach the next level and you will never be dependent on anybody's goodwill. It’s in your hand!

What we offer

Learning & Development

Enjoy dedicated training days and a budget for conferences and certifications to advance your skills.

Sports & wellness benefits

Stay active and energized with the Multisport card, giving you access to a variety of gyms, fitness classes, and wellness activities.

53k-63k Euros

We value your work and will always pay you accordingly. You'll get a market-competitive salary based on your skill level.

Choose your workplace

You are free to frequently work from wherever you work best, no matter if that's your kitchen, forest hut, or the library. However, be prepared to have meetings, and many productive hours in our super modern office in the heart of Warsaw.

Part of a community

Become part of a community where your ideas matter, knowledge is shared, and community drives growth and innovation.

Welcome

Meet your new workplace.

Once a month, on a Wednesday, we'll have an expanded breakfast and share knowledge about a certain topic at our amptalk. On another Wednesday, there's a team update, followed by a voluntary gathering with food and drinks. On top of that, expect off-sites, company-building workshops, and a lot of touchpoints to the Austrian startup scene.

Join

About Us

We actively create, shape and encourage an open culture. People with different backgrounds, experiences, and expertise work together in well-established teams.

Learn more

Thrive

Code of Conduct

The &amp community is driven by the desire for constant learning and teaching.

Discover

Interested?

Our hiring process

We take our time to get to know your best self.

Our hiring process is nothing like you've seen before.

We take our time to get to know you in a casual setting and then proceed to solve problems together in workshops. We care about your personality just as much as we care about your technical skills.

No matter the outcome, we'll always give you feedback and help you improve after your interview. Even if we aren't a fit.

Our application process

Send us your application per email

We look forward to your application and joining our team!
