Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
About The Role

The Business Data Analyst sits at the intersection of business strategy, product analytics, and data engineering. The role is responsible for transforming raw operational data into actionable insights that drive product features, customer acquisition strategies, and executive decision-making.

Working closely with cross-functional product, finance, and marketing teams, this role designs and maintains central reporting pipelines, conducts deep-dive exploratory analysis, and establishes the foundational metrics used to evaluate business health and strategy.

Key Responsibilities


Develop, maintain, and optimize business-critical dashboards and reporting pipelines in Tableau or Looker to track core KPIs
Write complex SQL queries to extract, clean, and aggregate large datasets from Snowflake or BigQuery data warehouses
Build and maintain robust, documented data models in dbt to support self-service analytics across business units
Perform exploratory data analysis and statistical testing to identify trends, diagnose performance anomalies, and validate business hypotheses
Partner with product managers and engineers to define telemetry and tracking requirements for new product features
Translate complex analytical findings into clear, structured presentations and written narratives for non-technical stakeholders


What We Are Looking For


3–6 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or analytics engineering in a fast-paced technology environment
Expert-level SQL proficiency, with the ability to write clean, performance-optimized queries and window functions over large-scale datasets
Hands-on experience with modern BI tools (Looker/LookML, Tableau) and data modeling frameworks (dbt)
Strong foundational understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and ETL/ELT pipelines
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with a track record of translating complex metrics into actionable business recommendations
Bonus: Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis, familiarity with product analytics tools like Amplitude or Mixpanel, or a BS in a quantitative field

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Company: Flow Control Group

About Us:

Flow Control Group (FCG) is a leading provider of fluid handling, process, and industrial automation solutions across North America. We are a 100% employee-owned organization made up of over 2,000 team members and 95+ entrepreneurial brands—each empowered to think big, move fast, and bring innovative ideas to life. Our ownership mindset fuels a culture of pride, accountability, and exceptional customer service.

At FCG, we believe in the power of partnership and entrepreneurship. We work collaboratively across our brands to drive growth, unlock new opportunities, and deliver real impact for our customers. This unique model allows us to combine local expertise with national strength, creating a dynamic environment where creativity meets practicality.

Visit our website: https://flowcontrolgroup.com/

FCG is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to help shape our data and analytics program by providing data analysis of source systems, defining data transformation rules for data warehouse development, delivering analytic applications, and working with end users to define and implement requirements while training and mentoring them to build skills with our toolsets. This position will be heavily focused on ERP data analysis for development of our Snowflake ecosystem, source-to-target mappings from ERP to our data warehouse, business partner collaboration, and development and support of data analytic products and users.

Key Responsibilities:


Interface with Business Partners: Work closely with end users to analyze and document requirements and ensure successful implementation of data warehouse and analytic solutions.
Solution Design: Collaborate with technical teams to design and implement solutions that meet business requirements and align with best practices.
Data Analysis: Analyze data from ERPs and our data warehouse for anomalies, quality, and adherence to standards. Identify transformations required to meet requirements. Become the SME for source systems and data ingestions.
Training and Support: Provide comprehensive training and support to end-users. Create and maintain detailed training materials and documentation.
Testing and Validation: Test data solutions and analytic applications to ensure that business requirements are met and perform as expected.
Master Data: Understand master data across the enterprise, support efforts to identify, document, and cleanse master data records, and interface with domain data stewards as needed.
Metadata: Work with business users, technical teams, and data stewards to create documentation, data dictionaries, and metadata to support end user understanding of enterprise data and analytic applications. Support and implement functionality in our metadata repository.
Development: Develop and implement data applications in BI tools to meet business requirements and enhance user experience. Create proof of concept solutions and evolve into a production-ready application.
Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and system enhancements to increase efficiency and effectiveness.


Qualifications:


Experience:
Proven experience working with business stakeholders to define requirements for analytic projects.
Minimum 3-5 years of experience with ERP systems like P21, SAP, NetSuite, or Business Central.
Minimum 2-3 years of experience with business intelligence tools like Power BI, Tableau, Sigma, Phocas, or Qlik.
Minimum 3 years of experience analyzing data sets to identify anomalies, data quality issues, and deviations from data requirements.
Proven experience designing and implementing data solutions and business intelligence applications in large-scale enterprise environments.
Experience in training and supporting end-users.
Minimum of 3 years working with cross-functional teams and managing multiple projects and priorities.
Additional Technical Skills:
Proficient in SQL and Snowflake.
Understanding of data management disciplines, including master data, metadata, data integrations, data warehousing, and data modeling.
Experience creating architecture diagrams as well as documenting requirements and design details.
Required Analytical Skills:
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to analyze data and compare to requirements to identify gaps in data or definitions.
Ability to effectively test data products and analyze data, looking for patterns and anomalies in the data that impact data warehouse and analytic deliverables.
Ability to analyze complex business processes and translate them into technical requirements.
Skill in evaluating end-user experience and usability in all designs.
Expertise working with users to define KPIs that align with business objectives.
Ensure alignment with data standards and data governance.
Communication Skills:
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to effectively communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Personal Attributes:


Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Self-Motivated: Proactive and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
Customer Focus: Strong commitment to delivering high-quality service to internal and external customers.

Title: Machine Learning Analyst
Description:
Bracebridge Capital, LLC is a leading alternative asset manager with approximately $12 billion of net assets under management. The firm pursues investment strategies primarily within the global fixed income markets with the objectives of capital preservation and absolute return without significant correlation to equity, interest rate and foreign exchange markets. Established in 1994, Bracebridge manages private investment funds that serve endowments, foundations, pension funds and other institutional and high-net-worth investors.

Approximately 170 employees operate from our office located in Boston’s historic Back Bay. The entrepreneurial and collaborative culture at Bracebridge rewards and supports motivated, dedicated, enthusiastic and intellectually curious individuals. We believe our firm’s greatest asset is the people who work here.

We are seeking a Machine Learning Analyst to join the growing data analytics and machine learning team. The team’s primary mission is to develop machine learning systems to answer open-ended investment questions and support portfolio management decisions. The team works across the project lifecycle and technical stack, from ideation, understanding and analyzing data, hypothesis generation and testing, and model development all the way through to the deployment and maintenance of models and systems in production. Our work spans statistical modeling, classical machine learning, and modern AI and LLM techniques.

The Machine Learning Analyst’s primary responsibility will be to contribute to these efforts alongside other team members. Over time, you will develop the technical and domain expertise needed to take increasing ownership of individual components and ultimately end-to-end projects.

The work is highly collaborative and spans quantitative research, software engineering, and machine learning. Analysts work with other members of the machine learning team and portfolio managers to translate loosely defined investment ideas into practical tools and models. Successful candidates will have solid programming foundations, be comfortable translating between qualitative and quantitative descriptions of problems and be excited to build data analysis and machine learning systems against the backdrop of portfolio management.

Since the team works closely with trading floor personnel to assist with portfolio management decision-making, an interest in economic and financial markets is essential, but no specific prior experience is necessary.

This role is open to candidates available to begin in the near term, as well as students expecting to complete their undergraduate degree between Fall 2026 and Summer 2027. Start dates will be determined based on candidate availability and, for students, degree completion.

Responsibilities


Collaborate closely with Machine Learning team members, portfolio managers, and researchers to translate open-ended investment questions into well-defined analytical and machine learning problems
Develop and evaluate data-driven machine learning and quantitative models, including simulation- and optimization-based approaches, for investment-related problems
Contribute to maintaining existing models and analytic tools in production
Over time, take ownership of individual features and components and full projects
Clearly document and communicate methods, assumptions, results, and limitations of models to other researchers and trading professionals across the firm
Stay current with relevant new techniques and technologies in machine learning and artificial intelligence, particularly as they pertain to finance and investing


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in a rigorous quantitative field
0-2 years of experience through industry internships, undergraduate research or thesis, or substantial independent technical projects involving software development, data analysis, or machine learning
Proficiency in Python and familiarity with the Python data science stack (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, etc), with experience in other languages a plus
Experience working with and analyzing data from multiple sources and in multiple formats
Familiarity with machine learning and statistical modeling fundamentals, including model evaluation and experimental design
Demonstrated ability to independently scope and execute open-ended technical projects
Interest in financial markets, intellectual curiosity, and comfort in working on open-ended problems
Strong written and verbal communication skills


Current anticipated annual base salary range: $110,000 - $145,000

Base salary within the range will be determined by various factors including but not limited to the individual's experience, skills and qualifications.

Title: Data Governance Analyst
Description:
SUMMARY/OBJECTIVE:
Northern Bank is advancing its enterprise data capabilities to support improved decision-making, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and responsible innovation. Enterprise Data Management (EDM) operates as a service-oriented function, partnering across business and technology teams to deliver trusted data, consistent reporting, and strong governance practices across the enterprise.

We are seeking a Data Governance Analyst to support and strengthen the Bank’s enterprise data governance program. This role will work closely with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards, risk partners, and technology teams to improve data quality, establish governance standards, document critical data elements, and promote consistent use of data across the organization. The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, collaborative, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, regulated environment while helping drive accountability and data trust across the enterprise.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
Support the execution of enterprise data governance initiatives across business and technology teams to improve the quality, consistency, and accountability of data assets.
Assist in establishing and maintaining governance processes related to data ownership, stewardship, classification, quality, lineage, and metadata.
Work effectively in a regulated environment, ensuring governance activities align with enterprise policies, control standards, and compliance expectations.
Facilitate collaboration across stakeholders to promote common definitions, data standards, and consistent use of critical data.
Help drive transparency and accountability for data-related issues, controls, and remediation efforts.
Adapt to evolving tools, regulatory expectations, and business needs while maintaining consistent governance practices.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Support implementation and ongoing administration of the enterprise data governance framework, including policies, standards, roles, and procedures.
Partner with data owners, data stewards, business units, IT, and risk partners to define and maintain critical data elements, business glossaries, and data lineage documentation.
Assist in monitoring and improving data quality by identifying issues, documenting root causes, tracking remediation, and coordinating with stakeholders on corrective actions.
Maintain and enhance governance documentation, including data definitions, ownership assignments, standards, issue logs, and control inventories.
Support governance forums, working groups, and review meetings by preparing materials, documenting decisions, and tracking follow-up items.
Help enforce consistency in data definitions, usage, and control practices across systems, reports, and business processes.
Contribute to metadata management activities, including cataloging key data assets and supporting traceability across source systems and reporting outputs.
Coordinate with reporting, analytics, and technology teams to ensure governed data is aligned with enterprise priorities and business needs.
Support policy adherence and control readiness by assisting with audits, exams, risk assessments, and internal reviews related to data governance.
Provide reporting and metrics on governance program maturity, data quality trends, issue resolution progress, and stewardship engagement.
JOB QUALIFICATIONS:
3+ years of experience in data governance, data management, data quality, business analysis, risk, compliance, or a related function.
Experience working with data in banking or financial services preferred, including awareness of regulatory, control, and reporting expectations.
Understanding of core data governance practices, including data ownership, stewardship, metadata, lineage, data quality, and policy standards.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify data issues and support practical remediation efforts.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain accurate documentation.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across business and technology teams.
Ability to translate data-related concepts into clear, actionable language for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience with Microsoft Office applications; familiarity with data governance, metadata, or reporting tools is a plus.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Data Management, Finance, or a related field.
NICE TO HAVES (OR THINGS YOU’LL GET TO LEARN):

About The Team

The People Analytics team is at the forefront of transforming how we understand and optimize our workforce. We are a dynamic group of analytical thinkers and storytellers who leverage advanced analytics and robust methodologies to create strategic insights from complex HR data. Collaborating closely with HR Business Partners, Program Management Teams, Business Operations, Talent Acquisition and various cross functional stakeholders we provide actionable insights that drives informed decisions across the entire employee lifecycle; from optimizing talent acquisition and development to enhancing engagement and retention. Our work directly shapes a thriving employee experience, fuels organizational growth, and ensures our people strategy is truly data-driven.

About The Job

The People Data Analyst owns the reporting and data quality foundation that enables our People Analytics team to deliver insights across Talent Acquisition and People Operations. You'll write the SQL, maintain the dashboards, run audits, and fulfill the ad hoc requests that keep our stakeholders informed and our data trustworthy.

This role is ideal for an early-career analyst who thrives on precision, wants deep exposure to HR data systems end-to-end, and is looking to build the technical muscle that underpins a career in people analytics. You'll work closely with our Senior Analysts — learning how upstream data work translates into downstream strategy while owning your own deliverables from day one.

What You'll Do


Provide critical support to the Senior People Data Analysts by executing standard data runs, owning reporting requests, and maintaining operational continuity across both TA and People Ops domains.
Write and optimize SQL queries against our data warehouse to extract, clean, and prepare datasets for analysis.
Maintain, troubleshoot, and perform minor enhancements on existing dashboards to ensure they remain accurate, functional, and up to date.
Own the execution of regular data quality audits across core systems (e.g., HRIS, ATS, LMS), identifying discrepancies and coordinating with internal systems admin teams to correct input errors.
Manage the intake and fulfillment of standard, internal ad-hoc data requests from various cross functional teams ensuring timely and accurate delivery.


Required Qualifications


1–3 years of professional experience in a data analyst, business intelligence, or HR operations role.
Solid proficiency in SQL for data extraction, joining tables, and data manipulation.
Intermediate to advanced Excel skills (e.g., pivot tables, index/match, formulas, data cleaning).
Hands-on experience navigating and utilizing business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) for data visualization and report generation.
Exceptional attention to detail with a proven track record of identifying data discrepancies and running quality assurance checks on large datasets.
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or technical field (e.g., Information Systems, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics) or equivalent practical experience.

Familiarity with HR systems and data structures (e.g., Greenhouse ATS, Gem CRM, Rippling, Workday).
Basic understanding of core HR and recruiting metrics (e.g., headcount, turnover, time-to-hire, pipeline conversion, retention).
Familiarity with data warehouse concepts or version control (e.g., Git).
Familiarity with Python or R for basic data manipulation tasks.
Familiarity with Palantir Foundry

$112,000—$149,000 USD

Title: Data Analyst I or II
Description:
Site: The Brigham and Women's Hospital, Inc.

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

Job Summary

The Data Analyst (I or II) reports to the CASI Research Administrative Manager, the CASI Center Director, and Division Leadership. Strong candidates for this role will have experience conducting observational data analyses, working with raw data from a variety of sources (e.g., administrative claims, electronic health record, etc.), and using large longitudinal datasets. The ideal candidate has strong analytic and methodological skills, excellent communication skills, and a personal mission to improve care for older adults or those living with serious illness.

Responsible for extracting knowledge and insights from data in order to investigate business/operational problems through a range of data preparation, modeling, analysis, and/or visualization techniques.

Essential Functions


Collects, analyzes, and reports data to support decisions on day-to-day operations, strategic planning, and/or specific business performance issues.
Collates, models, interprets, and analyzes data.
Explains variances and trends in data.
Identifies and documents enhancements to modeling techniques.
Completes thorough quality assurance procedures, ensuring accuracy, reliability, trustworthiness, and validity of work.
Performs data validation of source-to-target data for data visuals and dashboards.


Principle Duties And Responsibilities


The Data Analyst will work collaboratively with CASI and the Division to perform a variety of activities including assisting with program evaluation, statistical analysis, and reporting results for a variety of internal and external projects and constituents, database development, software programming, data management, dashboard creation.
This detail-oriented, motivated, and independent individual will work with large national survey, electronic health record (EPIC), and administrative claims datasets.
The Data Analyst will use SAS or other analytical software and other technical tools to clean data, build datasets, and run statistical analyses for multiple projects.
They will be responsible for translating evaluation questions into analytic plans, constructing analytic datasets by extracting raw data, including medical claims data, from electronic data warehouses and other sources as necessary, producing appropriate data summaries, and conducting valid data comparisons and statistical tests.
They will have the opportunity to evaluate health care delivery models, contribute to scientific discovery and scholarship and grow in knowledge and expertise.
They will be encouraged to learn new methodological skills to advance science and program evaluation using state of the art approaches.


Qualifications

Qualifications:


Bachelor's Degree Analysis required or Bachelor's Degree Related Field of Study required. Master’s degree preferred.
2 or more years of healthcare bioinformatics, and/or statistical analysis experience.


Can this role accept experience in lieu of a degree? Yes

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Healthcare knowledge, particularly as it pertains to electronic medical record data, is preferred but not required.
Working knowledge of relational databases, SQL, data visualization, and Business Intelligence tools such as Tableau.
Knowledge and application of statistical analyses, including variance analysis and statistical significance, are preferred.
Project management skills and/or experience are a plus.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to work well both independently and as part of a team.
Strong oral and written communication and presentation skills
Strong analytic and data management skills, especially with clinical and biostatistical analyses
Practical problem-solving and ability to move forward in a fast-paced environment
Ability to prioritize work, operate under tight deadlines, and meet deadlines.
Excellent organizational skills, accuracy, and attention to detail. Proficiency with software packages, including Microsoft Office suite.
Resilient, collaborative, flexible, innovative, and curious.
Strong programming skills in SAS and/or other analytic software and willingness to learn other programming languages as necessary.
Basic knowledge of statistical testing and multivariate modeling required (e.g., logistic, and linear regression, longitudinal models) used in Biostatistics/Epidemiology
Experience transforming and analyzing administrative healthcare data (e.g., Medicare/Medicaid, other claims-based or electronic medical records databases (EPIC)) is preferred.
Experience with compiling longitudinal datasets for analysis is preferred.
Is knowledgeable and compliant in all hospital, State and Federal regulatory requirements, including the Division’s code of conduct, the MGH mission, credo and boundaries, hospital policy and procedures (where applicable to the performance of the job), Joint Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations (JCAHO), and Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA)


Working Conditions


Fast paced and dynamic healthcare administration office.
Typical work hours are Monday through Friday days, but may vary based upon individual event demands, up to and including periodic evenings and weekend days.

Title: Data & Product Analyst (Benchmarking), CoStar Debt Solutions
Description:
Job Description

Data & Product Analyst (Benchmarking)

Location: Boston, in-office

About The Role

CoStar Debt Solutions is building the next generation of CRE analytics software — a platform where data, benchmarking intelligence, and client workflows come together in a single experience to support how lenders originate, evaluate, and manage risk.

A central part of this vision is our Benchmarking product, which enables lenders to compare loan performance, pricing, and risk characteristics against a trusted market dataset. This product is rapidly evolving, with significant investment in expanding coverage, improving methodologies, and delivering more actionable insights directly into client workflows.

We’re hiring a Data & Product Analyst to help drive the continued growth of this Benchmarking product — both as a data asset and as a highly client-facing solution.

This role combines data analysis, product development, and direct client engagement, with a strong emphasis on supporting client adoption and enabling the sales process. You will work closely with clients and internal sales teams to demonstrate product value, answer analytical questions, and ensure clients can effectively leverage benchmarking insights in their workflows.

In year one, this role will focus on analyzing benchmark data, supporting product enhancements, and actively participating in client meetings, product demos, and sales support activities. Over time, the role expands into shaping benchmark methodologies, influencing product strategy, and helping scale how benchmarking insights are delivered across the platform.

This is a hybrid role at the intersection of data analysis, product development, and client/sales engagement — ideal for someone who can translate complex datasets into clear insights and communicate them effectively to both internal and external audiences.

What You’ll Own


The analysis of complex datasets that power the Benchmarking product — identifying trends, inconsistencies, and opportunities to improve data coverage and quality
The evolution of benchmark methodologies, outputs, and usability in partnership with Product Managers and cross-functional teams
Direct engagement with clients, including leading and supporting client conversations to understand benchmarking use cases, answer analytical questions, and gather actionable feedback
Active support of sales and go-to-market efforts, including participating in product demonstrations, responding to client inquiries, and helping articulate the value of benchmarking insights
Ongoing client support and enablement, ensuring users can interpret and apply benchmark data effectively in their workflows
Collaboration with engineering teams to ensure accurate delivery of benchmark data, calculations, and features
Monitoring product usage and client feedback to identify areas for improvement and drive continuous enhancements
Data validation, quality checks, and troubleshooting to maintain the reliability and integrity of benchmark datasets
Staying current on industry trends and competitive benchmarking solutions to inform product direction


What We Expect You To Bring


Bachelor’s degree from an accredited, not-for-profit, in person, university or college. Ideally in Data Analytics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
2+ years of experience working with data analytics, financial data, or data-driven products
Strong hands-on experience working with large datasets and performing detailed analysis
Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical stakeholders and clients
Proven ability to support client-facing interactions, including presenting, explaining analytical concepts, and responding to client questions in real time
Experience with analytics or benchmarking products, or similar data-driven solutions
Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills
A track record of commitment to prior employers


Nice To Have


Exposure to SQL, Python, or similar languages
Experience with benchmarking, peer comparison, or performance analytics solutions
Experience supporting client-facing products or working in a customer-oriented environment
Familiarity with financial services, lending, or real estate data
Experience with data visualization tools
Understanding of APIs and data integration concepts


The Growth Path

The first year in this role is focused on deeply understanding the benchmark dataset, client needs, and current product capabilities — contributing directly to data analysis, active client engagement, sales support, and incremental product improvements. You will play a key role in client conversations, product demonstrations, and helping drive adoption of benchmarking insights in real-world workflows.

Beyond that, the role expands into a more strategic position:


Shaping how benchmark methodologies evolve as the dataset scales
Driving enhancements to how insights are surfaced within client workflows
Partnering with sales and client teams to improve how benchmarking is positioned, adopted, and delivered
Influencing product direction based on client usage patterns, feedback, and market trends


This role is a strong path into broader product ownership, client-facing product strategy, or advanced analytics leadership, particularly for someone interested in building and scaling data-driven products that directly support client outcomes and business growth.

What’s Unique About This Role

Most data analyst roles focus on generating insights. This role goes further — connecting those insights directly to product decisions and client outcomes.

You’ll Not Only Analyze Data, But Also


Work directly with clients and sales teams to translate insights into adoption and business value
Play a key role in client-facing discussions that shape both product direction and commercial success
Help bridge the gap between data, product, and revenue-generating activities


What’s in it for you?

When you join CoStar Group, you’ll experience a collaborative and innovative culture working alongside the best and brightest to empower our people and customers to succeed. We offer you generous compensation and performance-based incentives. CoStar Group also invests in your professional and academic growth with internal training, and tuition reimbursement.

Our Benefits Package Includes (but Is Not Limited To)


Comprehensive healthcare coverage: Medical / Vision / Dental / Prescription Drug
Life, legal, and supplementary insurance
Virtual and in person mental health counseling services for individuals and family
Commuter and parking benefits
401(K) retirement plan with matching contributions
Employee stock purchase plan
Paid time off
Tuition reimbursement
On-site fitness center and/or reimbursed fitness center membership costs (location dependent)
Access to CoStar Group’s Employee Resource Groups
Complimentary gourmet coffee, tea, hot chocolate, fresh fruit, and other healthy snacks


This position offers an annual base salary range of $99,000 - $133,000, based on relevant skills and experience and includes a generous benefits plan

We welcome all qualified candidates who are currently eligible to work full-time in the United States to apply. However, please note that CoStar Group is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

Title: Data Analytics & Management - Officer
Description:
About The Job

The Finance Data and AI Office (DART) delivers trusted data, analytics, and AI enabled solutions across Finance, Risk, and Treasury. This role sits within the Automation, Analytics & AI pillar and focuses on building practical, scalable solutions that address real finance challenges end to end—from problem framing and solution design through deployment and adoption—including data governance and internal control capabilities that align to regulatory expectations and standards.

Who We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with business curiosity and judgment and can thoughtfully apply emerging AI capabilities and low‑code/no‑code tools to build data solutions with tangible Finance outcomes—improving insight quality, controls, efficiency, and decision‑making.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Build Agentic AI & Copilot Solutions for Finance


Design and deliver agent‑based workflows that can plan, reason, and execute tasks across finance processes (with appropriate human oversight and controls).
Implement solutions that use LLM copilots for finance narratives, variance explanations, exception triage, and root‑cause analysis
Combine AI reasoning with deterministic logic (rules, thresholds, accounting constraints, materiality) to ensure reliability in controlled environments



Prompt Engineering & Context Design (Finance‑Grade)


Create and refine prompts grounded in finance context (e.g., P&L, cost centers, accounting rules, materiality thresholds) and structure outputs for decision‑making.
Build reusable prompt patterns, evaluation approaches, and guardrails to reduce hallucinations and increase consistency.



Apply Data Science Where It Matters


Use analytics and data science methods (e.g., anomaly detection, classification, forecasting support, explainability) to strengthen finance insight and controls.
Analyze large, complex datasets to identify breaks, drivers, trends, and actionable signals relevant to Finance operations and reporting.



Enable AI Using No‑Code / Low‑Code Platforms


Use no‑code and low‑code tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power BI, Power Platform or similar) to:
Operationalize AI outputs into finance workflows
Orchestrate AI‑driven steps alongside rules‑based logic
Surface AI‑generated insights, exceptions, and narratives to end users



Responsible AI & Controls‑Aware Delivery


Ensure solutions are explainable, auditable, and aligned with governance expectations
Validate AI outputs against financial data and business logic; design monitoring to maintain quality over time.



Regulatory Alignment, Data Governance & Controls


Contribute to BCBS 239 and broader regulatory aligned outcomes by improving traceability, accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and evidencing for critical finance/risk data used in aggregation and reporting
Ensure solutions delivered are consistent with broader regulatory expectations and embed appropriate data governance and controls from design through production



Skills And Experience Needed


Bachelor’s degree in AI, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
3-5 years of experience in emerging AI technologies, data science, analytics, automation (financial services preferred)
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills
Proficiency in SQL and Python
Familiar with data warehousing, data modelling, ETL concepts
Exposure to automation tools (e.g., low‑code platforms, RPA, workflow tools).
Understanding of Finance, Risk and/or Treasury business processes
Strong written and verbal communication skills



Knowledge of the below tools is preferrable


Microsoft Co-pilot Studio
Microsoft 365 Co-pilot
Databricks
Anthropic/Claude
Alteryx
Microsoft Fabric

$65,000 - $113,750 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Title: SomerStat Analyst
Description:
Statement of Duties

SomerStat, Somerville’s Division of Innovation and Analytics, provides timely analysis and reporting to help City staff and residents measure progress toward community goals and understand local challenges. By combining analytics, performance tracking, and open data, SomerStat empowers decision-making, improves city services, and keeps the community informed.

SomerStat analysts contribute to the core areas of SomerStat’s work: performance measurement, program evaluation, and analysis support for City staff and constituents. This includes contributing to individual efforts as well as to the development of frameworks that guide our work in these areas.

Analysts work in a multitude of topic areas with varied audiences and time horizons, and are expected to “own” projects from start to finish. Examples of work include developing internal and public-facing dashboards tracking progress toward the City’s goals; conducting and analyzing results from the biennial Happiness Survey and other survey efforts; and informing social service delivery supporting community welfare.

Below are the types of work an analyst could be expected to perform on a project. Almost no projects contain all these elements, and expertise across the board is not assumed nor required. However, interest in learning how to conduct all the work types below is a must:


Conceptual clarification: Working with City staff and other stakeholders on defining a research question, developing conceptual metrics
Creating data collection instruments: Usually surveys, occasionally other data collection protocols
Cleaning data: Scripting in R for categorization/transformation
Detail review & quality assurance: Data QA, reviewing surveys, memos, and visualizations
Conducting analysis: Using R, GIS, Tableau, or Excel
Creating visualizations: Using Tableau, GIS, or Excel/PowerPoint
Creating documentation & communication: Usually materials for presentation (slide decks) or narrative (written reports)
Setting up data pipelines: Scripting in R for optimization, automating processes to batch steps
Advising: On data collection and analysis strategy for other teams across the City, taking into account different needs and areas of expertise of our diverse workforce


Essential Functions

The essential functions or duties listed below are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment to the position.


Advances the core areas of SomerStat’s work by supporting the development and application of our frameworks in performance measurement, program evaluation, and analysis support efforts throughout the City
Conducts analysis projects from start to finish, including conceptualization, metric development, data selection or collection, analysis, presentation of findings and recommendations
Develops systemic access to appropriate data sources (including collecting new data as needed); creates and maintains automated data extraction and reporting workflows that clean and integrate relevant data to monitor performance and develop recommendations
Works independently with various interdisciplinary teams to determine how data analysis can best support municipal operational goals
Develops and delivers insightful reports, interactive dashboards, and presentations using visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, ArcGIS) to enable data-informed decision-making in the organization
Provides technical support, cross-training, and documentation to SomerStat and other municipal staff in use of SomerStat’s dashboards and other tools to ensure continued independent use of the developed solutions
Supports the City’s commitment to transparency by identifying new sources of data to make available to the public, preparing datasets for public use, and increasing public awareness and understanding of city systems and data
Supports the City’s commitment to equity by ensuring that data collected and/or selected for evaluation represent all the communities of Somerville, particularly those who are generally underrepresented in public engagement
Prioritizes accessibility and clarity in communication of data and results, to ensure that all constituents are informed about city goals and priorities, and our progress on their achievement
Participates in strategic communication and civic engagement efforts with staff, elected leadership, and the public
Ensures compliance with legal requirements and best practices to maintain the privacy and confidentiality of sensitive information; uses discretion and good judgement when calibrating access to data and reporting results
Assists other SomerStat staff in the performance of their duties as necessary


Recommended Minimum Qualifications

Education and Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in public policy, public administration, business, economics, urban planning, finance, statistics, computer science, political science or a similar field, and three (3) years of experience; or any equivalent combination of education, training and experience which provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Knowledge, Abilities And Skill

SomerStat, Somerville’s Division of Innovation and Analytics, provides timely analysis and reporting to help City staff and residents measure progress toward community goals and understand local challenges. ADUSA Distribution is the distribution company of Ahold Delhaize USA, providing distribution services to one of the largest grocery retail supply chains in the nation. What You'll Do (Role Overview)

As an Analyst III, Reporting and Analysis, you'll play a critical role in shaping how data drives decisions across our Distribution & Transportation network.

In this role, you'll go beyond building reports you'll unlock insights, influence strategy, and help leaders understand what's happening across the business and what to do next.

You'll work with large, complex data sets, translate them into meaningful stories, and provide clear recommendations that help drive smarter, faster decisions.

Why This Role Matters

Data is at the heart of how we operate and this role helps ensure we're using it to its fullest potential.

As a trusted partner to leadership, you will:


Turn data into actionable insights that drive performance
Support key initiatives across Distribution, Transportation, and Supply Chain
Help improve the tools, reporting, and analytics that guide our business forward


Your work will directly impact operational efficiency, strategic priorities, and overall business performance.

Turn Data into Insights


Analyze complex data sets to uncover trends, risks, and opportunities
Connect insights to broader Distribution & Transportation and Supply Chain strategies
Provide recommendations that help leaders make confident, data-driven decisions


Build & Enhance Reporting


Design, create, and maintain reporting that is accurate, scalable, and user-friendly
Deliver both recurring and ad hoc analysis based on evolving business needs
Ensure stakeholders understand and can effectively use reporting tools and outputs


Partner Across the Business


Collaborate closely with Distribution & Transportation leadership, Supply Chain teams, IT, and Data Governance
Gather and refine reporting requirements to deliver meaningful, impactful solutions
Serve as a key bridge between data and the business ensuring alignment and clarity


Solve Complex Problems


Perform advanced analysis to uncover deeper insights
Use business modeling to evaluate potential outcomes and guide decision-making
Proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, performance, and efficiency


Tell the Story Behind the Data


Transform large, complex data sets into clear, compelling narratives
Develop presentation-ready materials for leadership reviews and strategic discussions
Help leaders understand not just the data but the story, impact, and next steps


Drive Innovation & Continuous Improvement


Stay current on analytics tools and emerging best practices
Expand capabilities in reporting, visualization, and modeling
Support a culture of data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement


Be a Key Contributor


Provide subject matter expertise on analytics tools and reporting capabilities
Support key initiatives, projects, and cross-functional teams
Help champion change by using data to guide growth and transformation


What You Bring

We're looking for someone who is curious, analytical, and confident working with both data and people someone who enjoys solving problems and influencing outcomes.

Key Skills & Strengths


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience working with large data sets
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (Power Query, Power Pivots, etc.)
Experience with data visualization and analytics tools (Power BI, Alteryx, etc.)
Experience creating calculated expressions (DAX, Calculate fields, Excel Formulas, etc.)
Ability to query using SQL in Databricks
Knowledge of Power Automate and Power Apps
Ability to translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations
Strong storytelling and presentation skills
Knowledge of supply chain, inventory, forecasting, or distribution operations (preferred)
Strong organizational and time management abilities
Ability to collaborate, influence, and build relationships across teams
Creative, innovative thinker with a proactive mindset
Ability to navigate change and drive continuous improvement


Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree in business, economics, engineering, math, statistics, or a related field
Analytics certifications are a plus
3-5 years of experience in analytics, reporting, or a data-driven environment


What Makes This Opportunity Exciting


You'll work directly with leadership and influence real business decisions
You'll turn data into insights that drive measurable impact across the network
You'll gain exposure to multiple areas of the business and expand your influence
You'll help shape how analytics supports the future of Distribution & Transportation
You'll be part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement


Let's Build What's Next Together

If you're passionate about using data to tell stories, solve problems, and drive meaningful change, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

Salary


$75,040-112,560, depending on experience.

Title: Product Analyst
Description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring Product Analysts to embed across the product organization and serve as strategic analytics partners to teams across Healthcare, Algorithms, AI, Hardware, and other product areas. In this role, you will help define how WHOOP measures product success, uncover insights that shape roadmap decisions, and translate complex data into clear recommendations that improve the member experience. You will bring strong analytical rigor, product intuition, and intellectual curiosity to help teams make faster, smarter, and more impactful decisions with data.

Responsibilities


Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Design, and cross-functional leadership to inform strategy and roadmap decisions with data.
Own the analytical narrative for your product area, illustrated by defining KPIs, refining measurement frameworks, and surfacing insights that drive action.
Support experimentation and feature launches end-to-end: from defining success metrics to post-launch analysis and iteration.
Build scalable, self-serve reporting & tooling that lets your stakeholders make decisions without waiting on you.
Develop deep context on your product domain and use it to ask sharper questions, challenge assumptions, and push the product forward.
Proactively surface insights and recommendations that go beyond the ask; identify opportunities others haven't seen yet.
Collaborate with a high-performance analytics team in a fast-paced environment where intellectual curiosity is the baseline expectation.


Qualifications


You've done this before: 2-6+ years in an analytical role where you owned business-critical metrics or initiatives. (We're hiring across levels; we'll figure out the right fit together.)
You use AI tools proactively and hold AI-assisted work to the same bar as your own.
You can take a vague question, wrangle the right data, isolate insights, and communicate actionable recommendations to stakeholders who aren't data people.
You're a strong storyteller: you know how to make a compelling, concise case for action.
You're technically sharp: advanced SQL is table stakes. Familiarity with modern data stacks (Snowflake, dbt, ELT workflows) and visualization tools (Hex, Sigma, Amplitude, Looker) is a plus.
You have product sense: you think about the member experience, not just the numbers.
You're curious about how things work. Algorithms, hardware, health science: you don't need to be an expert, but you should want to understand.
You're a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and doesn't wait to be told what to work on.
TEAMS WE'RE HIRING FOR


We’re Looking For Multiple Analysts To Work Across Our Product Teams. During The Interview Process, We'll Work With You To Find The Right Team Fit Based On Your Interests And Strengths


AI Product: The future of intelligent coaching and personalized insights powered by AI/ML.
Algorithms: Where the science meets the product; sleep, recovery, strain, and how algorithmic outputs translate into member value.
Hardware Product: The physical device experience; sensors, wearability, and next-gen hardware.
Healthcare Product: Building WHOOP's Health Operating System; health outcomes, clinical features, personalized wellness.


This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $100,000 - $155,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

Title: Equis Analyst

Roux is seeking a Database Analyst with hands-on experience using EarthSoft’s EQuIS to support the management of environmental and chemical data for analysis and reporting. The ideal candidate is an experienced analyst with a desire to grow who can execute day-to-day EDD processing and project support while also supporting EQuIS database administration, configuration, and client-facing dashboard/reporting capabilities. This role will work closely with Roux’s existing environmental data management team as we expand Roux’s EQuIS-based service offerings. Candidate is expected to work from the Burlington, Massachusetts office three days per week at minimum.

Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree or higher in relevant technical field.
Minimum of 4 years of environmental data management experience, including practical use of EarthSoft’s EQuIS in a consulting or regulated environment.
Demonstrated experience processing and QA/QC’ing laboratory EDDs efficiently using EQuIS (EDP) (or comparable EDD workflow).
Working knowledge of EQuIS configuration/administration concepts.
Strong skills and proficiency with Microsoft-based software, including MS Access and MS Excel.
Interest and aptitude for building client-facing outputs (dashboards/reporting) using EQuIS dashboards.

Strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to manage multiple project priorities and tight schedules.
Strong written and verbal communication skills for coordination with project managers, laboratories, and technical staff.
Ability to help build and scale Roux’s EQuIS capabilities by training and supporting other staff, including analysts with prior database experience.


Essential Duties


Support environmental project teams by managing, processing, and quality‑checking environmental data in EQuIS to ensure datasets are accurate, complete, and suitable for reporting, compliance, and analysis.
Collaborate closely with project managers, scientists, engineers, and GIS staff to understand project requirements, prioritize data tasks, and deliver high‑quality data support under tight timelines.
Process laboratory and field EDDs in EQuIS (EDP), perform QA/QC and completeness checks, resolve common errors efficiently, and coordinate corrections with labs and project staff.
Support routine data tracking, data loading, and data delivery workflows.
Develop, run, and refine standard queries (SQL-based or within EQuIS) and reports to support project reporting needs.
Assist with EQuIS database administration and configuration activities, including management of reference values, formats, templates, and standard reports.
Develop client‑facing dashboards and reporting solutions (e.g., EQuIS-based and/or Power BI), working with project teams to translate technical data into clear, usable outputs for clients.
Help document workflows, QA/QC procedures, and guidance materials that improve efficiency, consistency, and quality across Roux’s EQuIS‑based data management services.
Provide hands‑on training and ongoing support to other staff in the use of EQuIS and related data management workflows, enabling consistent and effective use of the system across projects.


Base Salary Range: $75,000 - $95,000. This salary range is based on what Roux in good faith believes it might pay at the time of posting for this position and for this geographic location. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as relevant work experience, market conditions, education/training, certifications, skill sets, and internal equity. In addition, this position is eligible for performance bonuses based on individual job performance and the profitability of the firm.

Roux offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position including:


Medical, dental, and vision care coverage for employees and eligible dependents
401(k) profit sharing plan with employer match
Flexible Spending Accounts
Company paid life insurance and disability insurance
Supplemental life, long-term care, accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance
Employee Assistance Program
Paid Time Off including holidays, vacation, and sick leave
Paid Parental Leave

Title: Lead Data Analyst
Description:
Do you want to be a part of the clean energy movement? Are you passionate about improving our environment for this generation and those to follow? Are you ready to take on new challenges and collaborate with a future-focused team leading the way into new markets? Join Nexamp! 

This is where you can learn from industry leaders and become one yourself. It's fast-paced, mission-based work that challenges the status quo. Be on the team that's changing the world. 

What we’re looking for: 

We're looking for a Lead Data Analyst to craft insightful and compelling data stories, empower business owners across Nexamp to make more effective data-driven decisions, and help build our self-service data platform. As one of the nation’s largest and longest tenured solar and storage owner operators – and one of the few that is fully vertically integrated – our data is a differentiator in the market and a catalyst for future growth. You’ll be solving uniquely challenging data problems, alongside a strong team, and for a company in which the business model and mission are inseparably intertwined: our solar farms save customers money, help the planet, and are profitable for Nexamp and its investors. 

You will be hybrid out of our Boston office. You will report to the Director, Product Management - Data.

What you’ll do:  

Independently gather requirements for, prioritize, deliver, maintain, and continuously improve reusable data models, dashboards, analyses, A/B tests, and other data assets. Act as the product manager and implementer for your domain’s data offerings. Implement work using advanced SQL and BI tool skills.
Become the subject matter expert for data in your business areas. Identify opportunities for impact, proactively surface insights, support decision-making, and contribute to and influence business strategy and initiatives. Serve as your business stakeholders’ right hand. Support other business areas opportunistically.
Create and maintain comprehensive data documentation and communicate updates to your stakeholders. Write user stories or tickets for data engineering, validate data mapping, conduct QA, and implement data quality monitoring.
Monitor the usage of data assets, increase data literacy, and promote self-service through BI tools among stakeholders. Provide training, guidance, and support as needed.
Work within a centralized data team using agile methodologies. Collaborate with peer analysts through overlapping work, priority shifting, and code reviews to broaden your Nexamp knowledge.
Partner with the data architect, engineers, scientists, and analysts to shape the vision and roadmap for Nexamp’s data platform. Define and track annual OKRs to measure your impact. 

What you’ll bring:

7+ years of experience as a data analyst serving business owners and collaborating with data engineers (experience in the energy/construction industry is a plus, but not required)
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field would be preferred; advanced degree is a plus.
Advanced in SQL and BI tool administration and usage (experience with Databricks and Sigma are a plus, but not required)
Strong track record of independently solving problems.
Commitment to Nexamp's mission and have a passion for solving tomorrow's climate crisis today.
Demonstrated experience in effectively communicating information, ideas, and perspectives with people inside and beyond your organization.   
Experience in showcasing initiative to make improvements to current work, processes, products, and services across the organization. We value accountability and an ownership mentality. 
Ability to ask appropriate questions, analyze data, identify the root causes of problems, and present creative solutions. 
Expertise in building strong internal and external relationships with customers and stakeholders, instilling trust and loyalty across the industry. 
Eagerness to develop a fundamental understanding of how Nexamp operates and then apply that knowledge effectively to inform business decisions.

If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, but see yourself contributing, please apply.

At Nexamp, our mission is to build the future of energy so it is clean, simple, and accessible for all. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. By encouraging a culture where ideas and decisions come from all people, we believe it will help us grow, innovate, and be a part of environmental and social change.

You’ll love working here because:  

Not only will you get to take part in meaningful work and have the chance to change the world alongside innovative, dedicated, and motivated peers, but you will also have access to all the benefits that Nexamp offers! This includes our competitive compensation package; a 401(k) employer-match; health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one; flexible paid time off and holiday PTO; commuter benefits, and cell phone reimbursement. We have headquarters in Boston, MA and Chicago, IL, in addition to growing offices nationwide. We provide healthy snacks, coffee, service days and other volunteer opportunities, company outings, and more!  

Compensation

The reasonably estimated salary for this role at Nexamp ranges from $110,000 - $130,000. In addition to base salary, the competitive compensation package may include, depending on the role, participation in an incentive program linked to performance (for example, annual bonus programs based on individual and company performance, non-annual sales incentive plans, or other non-annual incentive plans). Additionally, you may be eligible to participate in the Company’s stock option plan. Actual base salary may vary based upon, but is not limited to, skills and qualifications, internal equity, performance, and geographic location. 

Nexamp's People team manages all aspects of recruitment and hiring within our organization. We want to inform third-party recruiters, staffing firms, and related agencies that Nexamp does not accept unsolicited resumes. Resumes will only be considered from these entities if a signed agreement is in place and the People team explicitly authorizes external recruiting assistance for a specific position. Any unsolicited resumes received will be deemed the property of Nexamp. We want to emphasize that Nexamp is not liable for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered)
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations


The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements. The Firm will provide reasonable accommodations as necessary to allow an individual with a disability to apply for and/or perform the essential functions of a position. If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, please contact HR.

Compensation And Benefits

Employees are entitled to compensation commensurate with skill and experience. The exact compensation will vary based on skills, experience, location, and other factors permitted by law. The expected compensation ranges for this position in various states and jurisdictions are as follows:


State of California: $116,000 - $237,000
State of Colorado: $107,000 - $191,000
State of Illinois: $105,000 - $204,000
State of Maine: $79,000 - $182,000
State of Maryland: $113,000 - $171,000
State of Massachusetts: $116,000 - $222,000
State of Minnesota: $116,000 - $192,000
Jersey City, NJ: $126,000 - $229,000
State of New York: $108,000 - $234,000
State of Vermont: $115,000 - $220,000
State of Virginia: $76,000 - $220,000
State of Washington: $113,000 - $214,000
Washington, D.C.: $150,000 - $220,000


The above salaries do not include a discretionary bonus, however bonus opportunities are non-guaranteed, and are dependent upon individual and firm performance. Full-time employees receive benefits including: medical and dental coverage; life insurance; short-term and long-term disability insurance; pre-tax flexible spending account for certain medical and dependent care expenses; an employee assistance program; Paid Time Off; paid holidays; participation in a retirement plan program after meeting eligibility requirements; and more.

Please include a cover letter and resume when applying.

EOE/Minority/Female/Disabled/Vet. Principal Applicants Only.

Experience building dashboards or reports using visualization tools (Tableau, Excel)

Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
Effective communication and stakeholder collaboration skills

Title: Modeling Analyst II
Description:
Join the Market Leader in Electric Power Data and Analytics Solutions

The electrical grid is the largest and most complicated machine ever built. Yes Energy’s industry-leading electric power trading analytics software provides real-time visibility into the massive amount of data generated by the North American electrical grid daily. Our unique and innovative view of the data informs real-time trading decisions and mid-to-long-term investment decisions that keep utility prices low, support the energy transition, and keep the grid running. It’s both challenging work and work with a purpose.

Be a part of our successful, growing business during international transformation.

Position Summary

As a Modeling Analyst II, you will be the subject matter expert on fundamental market price forecasting within our EnCompass product line. This role plays a critical part in ensuring that EnCompass meets the needs of our customers by providing advanced customer support to current and future customers, supporting product development and documentation, and testing and updating market databases for North America. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in power system modeling including production costing, market price formation, and economic transmission analysis.

This position requires close collaboration with Product Management, Engineering, and Sales to ensure the success of our customers, while also providing customer-facing expertise including day to day customer support, onboarding and training.

Position Details


Salary range: $110,000 - $140,000 plus bonus
Full-time
Hybrid or Remote
Reporting to: Senior Director, Customer Success
Travel requirement: Up to 30%


Primary Responsibilities


Ensure customers know how to use our products to their fullest potential by providing exceptional customer service, answering questions, troubleshooting issues, and providing technical support.
Engage existing and new customers in online and in-person training and onboarding - utilizing presentation skills, industry knowledge, and Yes Energy’s product expertise to maximize our customers’ product use experience.
Update and create product documentation, tutorials, and related materials.
Work closely with Product Management and Engineering to facilitate communication about product issues, user experience and to implement and test new EnCompass features.
Assist Power Infrastructure and partner companies in providing robust EnCompass databases for the North American power markets.
Provide subject matter expertise to Sales and Marketing to develop campaigns and participate in industry events.


Minimum Qualifications


Minimum of three years of experience in power system modeling, including market price forecasting, production costing, economic transmission analysis, and/or resource planning.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, or a related analytical field.
Experience using Excel or BI tools to analyze data.
Excellent communication skills.
Ability to troubleshoot complex modeling errors and guide customers through resolution.
Ability to travel to customer sites to provide in person training, up to 2 times per month.


Preferred Qualifications


Direct experience with EnCompass, PLEXOS, Aurora, or PROMOD models.
Familiarity with FERC regulations, ISO/RTO operations, and resource adequacy constructs.
Prior experience in a client-facing or consultative role, particularly within the energy sector.


At Yes Energy, we value connecting directly with candidates. We kindly ask that third-party recruiters and agencies not submit resumes, as we are not open to external recruiting partnerships.

Overview

ABOUT YES ENERGY

Yes Energy delivers real-time market data and electric power trading decision solutions. Over 1,000 market participants use Yes Energy solutions daily. The business is a leader in all aspects of information content collection and management, developing and delivering data and market analytics solutions. Since its inception in 2008, Yes Energy has become a trusted and respected supplier of innovative and reliable solutions focused on the needs of power market analysts, traders, and trade managers. Yes Energy has a team of over 350 amazing professionals in Boulder, CO (HQ); Boston, MA; Chicago, IL; Glendora, CA; Richmond, VA; London, United Kingdom; Auckland, New Zealand, Tokyo, Japan; and Bucharest, Romania.
